title: IT Systems Engineer
location: Athens, GREECE, Outside US and Canada
description:
Location: Halandri, Athens, Greece (ACS Athens)

Department: Technology Department

Reports To: Head of Technology

Position Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

ACS Athens is seeking a skilled and collaborative IT Systems Engineer to join our dedicated IT team. In this role, you will be the primary custodian of our core identity and systems infrastructure, ensuring that our 18 local servers, Azure/M365 hybrid environment, and 560+ Windows workstations run seamlessly.

This role includes actively engaging with our faculty, staff, and students to understand their technical needs, support their daily operations, and help plan practical software implementations that enhance the educational experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identity & Hybrid Cloud Management

    • Administer and maintain the Microsoft Local Active Directory infrastructure and its synchronization with Azure AD / Microsoft 365.

    • Manage user accounts, group policies (GPOs), permissions, and security groups for faculty, staff, and students.

    • Oversee the health, updates, and licensing within the M365 ecosystem.

  • Infrastructure & Server Maintenance

    • Monitor and maintain the school’s virtualized environment using VMware ESXi and vCenter.

    • Ensure the health, security patching, and routine maintenance of 18 on-premises Windows servers.

    • Assist with central software deployment and basic endpoint management (training will be provided on our internal deployment tools like SCCM).

    • Handle routine data protection tasks and system backups.

  • Hardware & User Support

    • Provide Tier 2/3 technical support for 560+ Windows workstations, as well as light support for occasional macOS and mobile devices (managed via MDM).

    • Interact directly with school staff and students to troubleshoot hardware/software issues, diagnose system bottlenecks, and gather requirements for new software deployments.

    • Collaborate with the broader IT team on network troubleshooting, leveraging a solid understanding of network protocols to diagnose connectivity issues before escalation.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field preferred (relevant certifications or equivalent practical experience will also be evaluated).

  • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Systems Administration, Technical Support, or a similar IT role.

  • Core Tech: Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Azure AD/M365 administration.

  • Networking Foundations: Good working knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol, core networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, subnetting), and basic troubleshooting tools.

  • Virtualization: Familiarity with VMware vSphere (ESXi/vCenter) operations (VM creation, monitoring, basic provisioning).

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. The ability to listen to non-technical users (teachers/students), understand their needs, and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Problem Solving: A methodical approach to troubleshooting hardware, OS, and software deployment issues.

  • Language: Fluency in English (written and verbal). Greek language skills are a plus but not required, as ACS Athens operates in an international English-speaking environment.

Why Join ACS Athens?

At ACS Athens, we are committed to excellence in education, student-centered innovation, and global leadership. If you are a forward-thinking educational leader ready to drive transformational change, we invite you to apply!

ACS Athens does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, genetic information, or disability in admission to, access to, employment in, or treatment in its programs and activities. description:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field

Special Knowledge/Skills:

Knowledge of computer network, hardware, and software applications

Knowledge of computer applications development and implementation

Ability to manage budget and personnel; coordinate district function; implement policy and procedure

Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

Five years of experience in supervision and management of an information systems department for a large organization

Technology and Information Management

title: Coördinator Bedrijfsvoering
description:
Een coördinator die niet inhoudelijk maar in de bedrijfsvoering richting en ondersteuning gaat geven. Een coördinator die samen met een coördinator inhoud, onder leiding van een manager bedrijfsvoering, het resultaat gaat neerzetten dat afgesproken is.

Ben jij dat? Dan zijn we echt op zoek naar jou!!

Bij het Centrum Bijzondere Tandheelkunde (CBT) van Jellinek bieden we specialistische mondzorg aan cliënten die te maken hebben met de gevolgen van verslavingsproblematiek. Onze tandartsen, tandartsassistenten en ondersteunende medewerkers zetten zich dagelijks in om deze doelgroep passende zorg te bieden.

Om ons team verder te versterken zoeken wij een Coördinator Bedrijfsvoering voor 16 uur per week, verdeeld over vier dagen. Deze functie is eventueel goed te combineren met een andere baan of opdracht.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Coördinator Bedrijfsvoering ben je de spil van de dagelijkse organisatie. Samen met de Coördinator Inhoud en onder leiding van de Manager Bedrijfsvoering zorg je ervoor dat de afdeling optimaal functioneert en haar doelstellingen behaalt.

Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig binnen het team, biedt structuur en overzicht en weet collega's te ondersteunen waar nodig. Dankzij jouw organisatietalent verlopen processen soepel en draag je bij aan een prettige en professionele werkomgeving.

In deze veelzijdige functie:

· ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor collega's binnen het team;

· bewaak je de dagelijkse voortgang, continuïteit en prioriteiten van de afdeling;

· signaleer je knelpunten en vertaal je deze naar concrete verbetervoorstellen;

· creëer je draagvlak voor veranderingen en verbeteringen binnen het team;

· stuur je waar nodig bij op planning, bezetting en werkverdeling;

· ondersteun je collega's bij praktische en organisatorische vraagstukken;

· zorg je ervoor dat protocollen, informatievoorziening en voorlichtingsmaterialen actueel blijven;

· draag je bij aan de organisatie van scholing en deskundigheidsbevordering;

· onderhoud je contacten met interne en externe samenwerkingspartners;

· organiseer en begeleid je teamoverleggen en treed je, indien nodig en in afstemming met de manager, op als voorzitter.

Wij bieden jou
Een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen met betrokken collega's lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan hoogwaardige zorg voor een bijzondere doelgroep. De voorwaarden zijn als volgt:

· Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO GGZ en een salaris in FWG 50;

· Een jaarcontract voor 16 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband na 6 of 12 maanden;

· Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%, 8,33% vakantiegeld en je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn.

Daarnaast een aantal aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden van Arkin:

· Voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen krijg je een 2e klasse mobiliteitskaart, ook te gebruiken voor OV-fiets, of een km vergoeding;

· Korting op verzekeringen bij Univé en Centraal Beheer;

· Arkin biedt met 11 specialismen op verschillende locaties ook veel mogelijkheden op langer termijn voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei. Hiervoor hebben we een breed trainingsaanbod;

· Een meerkeuzesysteem waarbij je brutoloon kunt gebruiken voor extra vakantie-uren, fietsaanschaf en aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding;

· Voor jouw welzijn een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1000 (naar rato dienstverband) en een jaarlijks vitaliteitsbudget van maximaal €100,- (bij een vast dienstverband van minimaal 18 uren per week) en toegang tot het platform Nrgize voor deelname aan activiteiten zoals bootcamp, yoga en salsa dansen. Daarnaast krijg je onbeperkt toegang tot het online cursusaanbod van GoodHabitz.

· Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van €1000,-

Wat breng je mee?
Je staat stevig in je schoenen en blijft rustig als het druk is. Je ziet wat er nodig is en wacht niet af. Tegelijk werk je graag samen en kun je goed luisteren. Je vindt het leuk om collega’s te ondersteunen en mee te denken over hoe het werk slimmer of beter kan. Je kunt schakelen tussen cliëntenzorg en coördinatie.

Verder:

· heb je hbo werk- en denkniveau;

· heb je ervaring in de zorg;

· kun je goed organiseren en overzicht houden;

· communiceer je duidelijk en respectvol;

· heb je affiniteit met bedrijfsvoering;

· en heb je affiniteit met verslavingszorg of psychiatrie.

Ervaring in een coördinerende functie is een pré, maar geen vereiste. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je initiatief toont, eigenaarschap neemt en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen in deze rol.

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende uitdaging? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je!

    Werken bij Jellinek
    Jellinek is dé expert op het gebied van verslaving. Jellinek heeft als eerste in de verslavingszorg een TOPGGz erkende afdeling en biedt daarmee kwalitatief hoogwaardige zorg. We bieden ondersteuning bij verslaving in de breedte: van preventie tot behandeling.

    Het (dag-)klinisch team in Amsterdam bestaat uit een multidisciplinair team van ongeveer 55 collega's. Als masterpsycholoog werk je samen met onder andere GZ-psychologen, verpleegkundig specialisten, klinisch psychologen, groepswerkers, verpleegkundigen, verslavingsartsen en psychiaters.

    We behandelen op basis van de missie en visie van Jellinek, met een focus op wetenschappelijk onderbouwde (evidence based) behandelmethoden zoals cognitieve gedragstherapie (CGT) en acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT). Naast verslavingsproblemen behandelen we ook veelvoorkomende comorbide klachten, zoals angst- en stemmingsstoornissen, PTSS en ADHD. We bieden zowel groepsbehandelingen als individuele trajecten aan.

    Je kunt rekenen op een open, directe stijl van leidinggeven, met veel aandacht voor een goede teamsfeer. We hechten veel waarde aan collegialiteit en plezier in het werk, dat zorgt voor een prettige, betrokken werkomgeving waarin we elkaar ondersteunen en versterken.

    Jellinek is één van de 11 specialismen van Arkin. Samen zijn we de expert op het gebied van de psychiatrie en verslavingszorg. Met elkaar maken we ons sterk voor de mentale veerkracht van onze cliënten.

    Meer weten over deze vacature?
    Ben je enthousiast geworden naar deze functie of heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Franca Hasenbos, manager bedrijfsvoering, via franca.hasenbos@jellinek.nl

    Bij Arkin omarmen we diversiteit en streven we naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin we het beste in elkaar naar boven halen. Meer over onze visie op D&I lees je bij 'over ons'.

    Wij zoeken het liefst zelf naar nieuwe collega’s, dat vinden we wel zo persoonlijk. Acquisitie wordt dan ook niet op prijs gesteld.

    Reageren kan zolang de vacature online staat. Hebben wij een nieuwe collega mogen verwelkomen dan wordt de vacature gesloten.

title: Student Data & Systems Analyst
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Student Data & Systems Analyst is a highly technical, data-focused position responsible for the administration, analysis, accuracy, reporting, and integrity of student information and data systems across New Horizons Regional Education Centers (NHREC).

This position serves as NHREC’s primary technical resource for PowerSchool, Microsoft Excel, student data management, state reporting, transcript processing, data analysis, and academic reporting. The Analyst works extensively with large and complex datasets and is responsible for entering, compiling, analyzing, validating, reconciling, and reporting student information for internal and external stakeholders.

Extensive knowledge and demonstrated professional use of Microsoft Excel is required for this position. The successful candidate must be highly proficient in Excel and capable of independently using advanced Excel functions and tools to organize and analyze large datasets, reconcile information from multiple sources, identify discrepancies, develop reports, and support data-driven decision-making.

The position also supports student registration, enrollment, and recruitment data processes in collaboration with public high schools in NHREC's seven partner school divisions, school counselors, administrators, faculty, students, and parents.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as NHREC’s primary administrator and technical resource for PowerSchool, including system management, troubleshooting, reporting, user support, and training.
  • Utilize Microsoft Excel extensively to enter, analyze, organize, validate, reconcile, and report student and program data.
  • Develop and maintain Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and reports using advanced functions such as PivotTables, formulas, filtering, and data validation.
  • Import, export, clean, analyze, and reconcile large datasets from PowerSchool and other information systems.
  • Conduct data audits to identify discrepancies, errors, and missing information and ensure overall data integrity.
  • Maintain accurate student records, including enrollment, grades, attendance, demographics, test scores, and transcripts.
  • Coordinate student registration and enrollment data for CTE and Governor’s School programs and NHREC’s seven partner school divisions.
  • Prepare and distribute student achievement, enrollment, grade, compliance, and statistical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyze student data to support program evaluation, school improvement, and administrative decision-making.
  • Oversee required student data collections, including CTE Student Completer Survey reporting.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree from an accredited institution or five years of relevant experience in data analysis, student information systems, educational data, school division records, data reporting, or a related technical/data-management function is required.
  • Extensive knowledge and demonstrated professional use of Microsoft Excel required.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently work with large and complex datasets and accurately enter, analyze, reconcile, and report information.
  • Strong working knowledge of student information systems, preferably PowerSchool.
  • Experience generating, analyzing, validating, and presenting data reports.
  • Experience working in a public school division or educational environment preferred.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is an essential function and minimum technical requirement of this position. The candidate must demonstrate extensive professional experience using Excel for data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong technical knowledge of student information systems, with PowerSchool experience strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of student registration, enrollment, scheduling, grading, and records-management processes.
  • Ability to maintain and verify large volumes of student information with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Ability to compile and reconcile information from multiple systems and sources.
  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, missing information, and reporting errors.
  • Ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships with administrators, faculty, staff, students, families, counselors, and representatives from partner school divisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical projects, reporting cycles, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of FERPA, educational records requirements, and public school procedures.
  • Ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently, identify technical or data-related problems, and develop appropriate solutions.

description:

General Description:
The Cybersecurity Technician supports the protection of the school division’s digital systems,
networks, and data. This entry-level role focuses on monitoring systems, assisting with
security measures, responding to security incidents, and promoting safe technology practices
among staff and students. The position plays a key role in safeguarding sensitive student and
staff information while maintaining compliance with education and data privacy regulations.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • monitor security tools and alerting software for suspicious activity.
  • Review alerts and reports and escalate potential threats.

  • Document incidents and actions taken.
  • Create and maintain cybersecurity policies and internal processes.
  • Audit technology environment to ensure compliance with internal controls and policies.
  • Serve as subject matter expert for cybersecurity in stakeholder meetings to provide division-wide guidance and best practice information.
  • Perform vetting processes for new software requests across the division.
  • Perform role-based security awareness training for privileged users.
  • Create and implement phishing campaigns and associated educational materials.

  • General understanding of threat hunting and management techniques
  • General understanding of threat management, vulnerability management, patch management, SIEM, SOAR, MDR, XDR, security auditing, pen testing.
  • General understanding of attack techniques includes ransomware, phishing, trojans, malware, root kits, spyware, DDOS, spoofing, hijacking, MITRE, and social engineering.
  • General understanding of computer networks, operating systems, and cloud-based environments (IaaS, SaaS, PaaS)
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

title: Quality Control
description:
Job Title: QC Civil Engineer
Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
Experience: 5+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Quality Control / QA-QC

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced QC Civil Engineer with 5+ years of experience in quality control and quality assurance for civil construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all civil works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project quality plans, applicable standards, and company requirements.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of construction materials, inspection procedures, testing, documentation, and quality management systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and inspect all civil construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality standards.
  • Conduct inspections of:
    • Earthwork and excavation
    • PCC and RCC works
    • Reinforcement and shuttering
    • Foundations and structural works
    • Masonry and blockwork
    • Plastering and finishing works
    • Waterproofing works
    • Flooring and tiling
    • External development and civil works
  • Review construction drawings, specifications, method statements, ITPs, and checklists.
  • Prepare and implement Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, and inspection procedures.
  • Raise and close Inspection Requests (IRs) in coordination with consultants/client representatives.
  • Conduct material inspections and verify materials against approved specifications and material submittals.
  • Coordinate with third-party laboratories for testing of concrete, soil, aggregates, steel, bricks/blocks, waterproofing materials, etc.
  • Monitor concrete sampling, cube testing, slump tests, and other required site tests.
  • Ensure proper documentation and traceability of test reports and inspection records.
  • Identify non-conforming work/materials and raise NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) where required.
  • Follow up on corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely closure of NCRs.
  • Monitor workmanship and ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the project.
  • Coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, and project management teams to resolve quality-related issues.
  • Verify that approved materials and construction methods are being used at site.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports.
  • Maintain records of inspection requests, test reports, material approvals, NCRs, and quality documentation.
  • Participate in quality audits and site inspections.
  • Assist in preparation and implementation of project Quality Assurance / Quality Control plans.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable IS Codes, ASTM standards, project specifications, and relevant construction standards.
  • Provide technical guidance to site teams to prevent recurring quality issues.
  • Support project handover by ensuring all quality documentation and inspection records are complete.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Civil QA/QC.
  • Experience with a main contractor, EPC contractor, developer, or construction company preferred.
  • Experience in building construction, commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.

title: IVF analist
description:
“Het Behandelcentrum Voorburg, onderdeel van de Reinier de Graaf Groep, staat bekend om haar verregaande medische expertise op het gebied van zorg voor Moeder en Kind, werken in ons prachtige nieuwe IVF-lab maakt dat nog eens extra bijzonder.” zegt Ellen Rijnders, klinisch embryoloog en hoofd IVF-lab.

Je zet jouw kennis en kunde in om mensen met een kinderwens te helpen deze te realiseren. Een bijzondere en dankbare taak waarbij jouw werk direct impact heeft op het leven van onze patiënten.

De IVF-kliniek Voorburg biedt alle mogelijkheden voor onderzoek en behandeling onder één dak: IUI, IVF, ICSI en cryopreservatie van eicellen, zaadcellen en embryo’s. Daarnaast hebben we een eigen semenbank. De patiënt staat bij ons centraal en samen kijken we welke behandeling het beste past bij de persoonlijke situatie.

In het IVF-laboratorium werk je samen met een team van analisten en embryologen aan alles wat komt kijken bij IUI-, IVF- en ICSI-behandelingen. Je houdt je bezig met onder andere de bewerking van zaad- en eicellen en het kweken, invriezen en ontdooien van eicellen, semen en embryo’s. Je rapporteert aan het hoofd van het IVF-laboratorium.

Je werkt veel samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines, zoals artsen en verpleegkundigen. Samen bespreek je bijvoorbeeld de fertiliteitsbehandeling, het verloop daarvan en de planning van afspraken. Ook lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de kwaliteit binnen het IVF-laboratorium. Je werkt volgens protocollen, denkt mee over het verbeteren hiervan en draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van processen binnen het kwaliteitssysteem, bijvoorbeeld als intern auditor.

Je hebt veel contact met onze patiënten. Je maakt afspraken, bespreekt bevruchtingsresultaten, plant embryotransfers en geeft uitleg over embryokwaliteit en de keuze van embryo’s voor terugplaatsing. Je weet complexe informatie op een duidelijke en prettige manier uit te leggen en hebt daarbij oog voor de emoties en wensen van de patiënt. Met jouw deskundigheid en betrokkenheid zorg je ervoor dat patiënten zich gehoord en goed geholpen voelen.

Deze functie vraagt om iemand die initiatief neemt, nauwkeurig werkt en verantwoordelijkheid durft te pakken. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar bent tegelijkertijd een echte teamspeler. Een goede oog-handcoördinatie en sterke concentratie zijn belangrijk, zeker bij het werken met de microscoop. Jij weet hoe belangrijk jouw werk is en gaat daarom zorgvuldig en professioneel te werk.

Je komt terecht in een kleinschalige afdeling met 24 collega’s. We kennen elkaar goed, hebben korte lijnen en werken in een prettige en vertrouwde sfeer. Na een inwerkperiode draai je mee in de weekend- en feestdagendiensten, met minimaal 13 diensten per jaar. Daarnaast draai je mee in de alarmdiensten. De IVF-kliniek is namelijk 365 dagen per jaar geopend.

Wil jij met jouw kennis, precisie en persoonlijke aandacht bijdragen aan het realiseren van een kinderwens? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wij vragen

  • Je hebt de HLO/ HBO-laboratoriumopleiding afgerond (bij voorkeur in weefselkweek of microbiologie)
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands
  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Maximale reisafstand 30 minuten buiten werktijd, in verband met alarmdiensten
  • Kennis van kwaliteitssystemen (ISO) is een pré.

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van IVF analist? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Charisse van Egmond, recruiter

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Ellen Rijnders, Klinisch embryoloog (070 340 1128) en Linde Woudstra, klinisch embryoloog. (070 340 1158) helpen je graag.

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Charisse via 06 - 23 48 43 95.

Solliciteren kan tot en met 27 september 2026. De sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland op 5 en 6 oktober.
Bij een overweldigend aantal reacties kan het zijn dat we de vacature toch eerder sluiten dan de genoemde sluitingsdatum. Wacht dan ook niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum.

title: Director of Technology
description:
The Director of Technology serves as the district's technology leader and is responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, management, security, and continuous improvement of technology systems, digital learning environments, cybersecurity initiatives, student data privacy programs, instructional technology resources, and information systems. The Director collaborates with district and school leaders to ensure technology supports teaching and learning, operational effectiveness, safety, innovation, and equitable access for all students and staff. 
Supervisory Responsibilities
Supervises technology department personnel and contracted technology service providers as assigned. Responsible for the supervision, evaluation, professional growth, and coordination of staff supporting district technology operations, cybersecurity, digital learning, infrastructure, and information systems.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Leads the planning, deployment, management, and continuous improvement of the district's technology program, including device lifecycle management, inventory control, replacement planning, and user support. 
Monitors district applications, digital platforms, infrastructure, and technology services to ensure reliability, security, availability, and continuity of operations. 
Prepares reports, technology plans, compliance documentation, procedures, training materials, project updates, and other communications to support district operations and technology initiatives. 
Serves as the primary liaison among district stakeholders, vendors, service providers, community partners, and governmental agencies regarding technology initiatives, support services, compliance requirements, and strategic planning. 
Provides leadership and consultation regarding technology planning, system requirements, cybersecurity, digital learning, data governance, and emerging technologies to support district goals and initiatives. 
Collaborates with curriculum and instructional leaders to support the effective integration of technology into teaching, learning, assessment, and student engagement. 
Oversees the design, administration, security, maintenance, and continuous improvement of district technology infrastructure, enterprise systems, student data systems, cloud services, backup systems, disaster recovery processes, cybersecurity controls, and data privacy safeguards.
Evaluates, selects, upgrades, and implements technology systems, software applications, and digital resources to improve instructional, operational, and data management functions across the district. 
Develops technical requirements and oversees system integrations to ensure efficient, secure, and effective exchange of information across district platforms and applications.
Oversees the testing, implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of district software applications, vendor-supported systems, and digital resources to ensure reliability, security, accessibility, and alignment with district objectives.
Coordinates technology projects from planning through implementation, including timelines, stakeholder communication, resource allocation, and project evaluation. 
Develops and coordinates professional learning, user support resources, and training programs related to technology systems, cybersecurity, digital citizenship, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies. 
Assists with development, implementation, and monitoring of district technology policies, procedures, and standards, including those related to technology resources, internet safety, cybersecurity, digital citizenship, artificial intelligence, and student data privacy. 
Leads and participates in district, state, regional, and professional committees, planning initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts related to technology and innovation. 
In collaboration with district and school leadership, develops, implements, and monitors all aspects of the technology budget, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, instructional technology, software licensing, digital resources, telecommunications, technology-related grants, E-Rate funding opportunities, and replacement cycles.

title: Inventory Control Clerk
location: Headquarters Corporate Offices - El Paso, TX 79901
description:
Become a part of the Economy Team

A Little About Us

What started as a family business in a small, two-story building at 219 S. Ochoa in 1958 now includes multiple sites, a distribution center, and a customer service center, with goals of further expansion in the near future. As a family-run business, we care about the people and areas we serve. Our market knowledge, cross-border partnerships, export services, and professional bilingual team have helped make Economy Wholesale Grocers the regional leader in wholesale commerce, serving the U.S. and Mexico.

What we are looking for

Highly motivated individual who provides outstanding customer service by supporting inventory accuracy and integrity through cycle counts, inventory audits, discrepancy research, item master maintenance, and physical inventory activities. This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, accurate documentation, and the ability to work with multiple departments to maintain reliable inventory records.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Inventory Management

  • Performs daily cycle counts and verifies physical inventory against system quantities, units of measure (UOM), and inventory locations.
  • Research inventory variances by reviewing relevant transactions such as receiving, transfers, sales, fulfillments, and adjustments; perform recounts when necessary and documents the results.
  • Processes or submits inventory corrections and adjustments according to established procedures and approval levels.
  • Reviews inventory exception reports, including shorts, empty bins, slow-moving inventory, and other assigned reports, and follows up as needed.
  • Identifies recurring inventory issues or unusual/high-value discrepancies and escalates them to Inventory Management

Product Control & Physical Inventory

  • Reviews short-dated and expired inventory and perform audits of product rotation, damages, storage, labeling, and quality.
  • Verifies that damaged, expired, donated, disposed, returned, or otherwise removed inventory is properly documented and reflected in the inventory system.
  • Assists with the preparation and execution of periodic physical inventories, recounts, and audit preparation.
  • Assists with training and guiding employees for physical inventory, including counting procedures, UOM, item identification, documentation, and use of inventory counting equipment or systems

Item Master & Inventory Documentation

  • Maintains assigned item master data, including verification of UPCs, item descriptions, UOM, pack sizes/conversions, and other required item information.
  • Sets items as active or inactive as needed and authorized, and identifies duplicate, incorrect, or incomplete item records for correction.
  • Reviews purchase orders, invoices, packing slips, transfer records, or other source documents when needed to support inventory research or verify inventory transactions.
  • Maintains organized and accurate supporting documentation for inventory counts, adjustments, damages, expirations, transfers, and other assigned inventory-control activities

Department Support & Compliance

  • Works with Receiving, Warehouse, Purchasing, Sales, and Operations when inventory information or assistance is needed to resolve an issue.
  • Audits incoming, outgoing, or transferred inventory when requested to confirm the correct item, quantity, UOM, and location.
  • Follows established inventory-control procedures, internal controls, safety requirements, and assigned timelines.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned by management

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED; at least one year of warehouse, inventory control, receiving, or directly related experience preferred.
  • Experience with ERP, warehouse management, or inventory systems preferred; NetSuite and RF-SMART experience is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with good mathematical, organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions, research discrepancies, maintain accurate records, and work independently or with multiple departments.
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to accurately review and enter inventory and item master information.
  • Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel between company warehouses and store locations as required.
  • Warehouse experience and ability to safely navigate warehouse, cooler, freezer, and storage areas.
  • Stand-up forklift certification preferred

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, bend, stoop, kneel, climb ladders, and use handheld or computer equipment.
  • Frequently required to lift, push, pull, or carry items up to 50 pounds and safely access inventory stored at high and low locations.
  • May work in cooler or freezer environments ranging approximately from -10°F to 40°F and may be exposed to outside weather conditions.
  • Frequently works near forklifts and other moving warehouse equipment and in areas with elevated noise levels.

Benefits:

  • Low Cost Medical Coverage
  • Company Paid Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Short-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off
  • Company Holidays

Location:

Rotating between 100 S. Cotton St., 1500 E. Paisano Dr. and 411 N. Zaragoza Rd.

Working hours:

Monday to Friday rotating scheduled can be:

  • 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  • 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  • 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

title: Systems Administrator I
description:
All education provided on your application must be supported by attaching a scanned copy of your high school diploma, transcription or college/university transcript.

Work Year Calendar and Hours

  • 12-month position (260 days / year), 8 hours per day
  • Daily work hours: TBD


For more information about employee benefits please go to:

Salary

  • Technology Salary Scale Grade T19: $44.74 per hour; starting


Under the Fair Labor and Standards Act this position is exempt from overtime. Actual salary placement will be in accordance with the salary procedures of the Frederick County Public School System. Please see linked salary scale for the full range.

Role

The Systems Administrator I provides support, technical direction and expertise of enterprise systems and infrastructure, including planning, administering, and implementing all Information Technology/Information Systems requirements. This position also performs systems administration related duties with a primary focus on enterprise IT/IS infrastructure (storage, email, virtualization, databases) and other core layer technologies.

Essential Functions

Reporting directly to the Supervisor of Network Infrastructure and Security, the Systems Administrator I performs the following duties:

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of all IT/IS infrastructure including storage, applications, databases, email services, systems management, network resources and server/virtual infrastructure. This includes scheduling upgrades and maintenance that minimally impact core business and instructional functions. Performs off hour upgrades, installing patches, service packs, maintenance releases, troubleshooting, etc.
  • Automate tasks and improve operational efficiencies by designing VBS, PowerShell or related scripts.
  • Installs, configures, maintains and troubleshoots all network resources including servers, network infrastructure, virtual infrastructure, storage, applications, and sub-systems.
  • Implements and maintains Information Systems security as mandated by state, county, and internal requirements. Performs routine system audits and vulnerability assessments, verifies IS security compliance.
  • Performs multi-tiered incident, change management, problem resolution, and end-user support.
  • Monitors faults, performance, and capacity issues; prepares remediation reports and documentation.
  • Proactively researches, analyzes, identifies and resolves trends of utilization or errors and implement appropriate performance tuning and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Continuously identifies opportunities for process and quality improvement and implements applicable technologies and/or process changes.
  • Implement and configure highly available infrastructure including design and test of fail-over services, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, load balancing, etc.
  • Implement and configure systems management and proactive monitoring tools; troubleshoots and resolves identified telecommunication and network issues.
  • Implement and oversee backup systems. Protect all systems and end user data: schedule and maintain onsite and offsite backups, review backup logs, develop and maintain backup procedures, restore data and configurations, document recovery plans, and implement new backup technologies.
  • Document all systems administration processes and installation procedures.
  • Interfaces with internal and external customers and vendors to determine network infrastructure needs.
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.


Other Essential Functions

  • Remain technically current and competent by learning new technologies and obtaining certifications as requested by management.
  • Manage and oversee network bills and services, manage purchasing of Information Systems infrastructure, open and work with TAC cases to resolve issues.
  • Performs other duties as required.



Performs other duties as assigned by the Supervisor of Network Infrastructure and Security.

Required Qualifications

  • Associates Degree or equivalent certifications/training/experience in information technology, computer science, engineering or related field.
  • CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft MSCE/MCITP or related certification.
  • Four (4) years' full time experience providing systems administration within a large scale network infrastructure including experience administrating Windows and/or Linux servers.
  • Experience with and must be able to install, troubleshoot, administer and maintain enterprise virtualization, e-mail, database, storage, systems management and/or other data center related resources and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience with and ability to implement, configure and troubleshoot Windows Servers and services, Active Directory, NAS shares, group policies, provisioning storage, package and deploy network based applications, etc.
  • Experience and broad knowledge of TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, SNMP, SMTP, iSCSI, RFC's, and other network protocols, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience with network monitoring tools, preferably Microsoft SCOM and WUG.
  • Demonstrated experience performing and analyzing network packet captures using packet analyzers such as Wireshark.
  • Ability to work off-hours as needed/required.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently and effectively complete work assignments and projects in a timely fashion.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
  • Capable of performing the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft MSCE/MCITP, VMWare VCP or related certifications.
  • Experience or good understanding of fiber channel or FCOE.
  • Experience and broad knowledge of routing protocols, switch protocols.
  • Experience with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure or related technology.
  • Experience with desktop management preferably Microsoft SCCM.
  • Experience creating Powershell, VBS or other related scripts.
  • Experience implementing high availability network systems and network load balancing.
  • Work experience in K-12 educational setting.
  • Familiarity with the FCPS policies, goals and programs.

Summary/Objective

The Facilities Director is responsible for training and managing the Facilities Maintenance crews for Volunteers of America Northern Rockies’ (VOANR). The director is also responsible for ensuring the VOANR facilities, grounds, and vehicles are maintained to organizational standards. This individual is responsible for approving work orders, maintaining the work order system, and submitting and approving invoices for facility maintenance.

Essential Functions

  • Plan, prioritize, assign, supervise, review, and participate in the work of staff responsible for facility and vehicle maintenance
  • Establish schedules and methods for providing facility maintenance services
  • Provide leadership to the Facilities Maintenance crew to ensure VOANR facilities and grounds are kept to high standards
  • Identify property and resource needs, review needs with appropriate management staff, and allocate resources accordingly
  • Work with staff to identify facility needs within programs
  • Provide support to the planning and implementation of facility projects
  • Provide support and input for safety efforts for the organization
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and completion of facility projects
  • Participate in the preparation and administration of the facility maintenance budget and submit budget recommendations; monitor expenditures; prepare cost estimates for equipment with justifications; monitor budget expenditures
  • Assist when needed to program staff budget recommendations and expenditures
  • Monitor and control supplies and equipment for property and grounds. Order supplies and tools as necessary; prepare documents for equipment procurement
  • Assist in training in facility maintenance and safety methods, procedures, and techniques
  • Establish, perform, and evaluate the preventive maintenance programs for all facilities, equipment, and vehicles
  • Track and maintain all vehicle inspection documents; provide feedback to program staff with vehicle maintenance recommendations and repair procedures
  • Coordinate construction projects, remodeling, and special projects being performed by maintenance staff.
  • Assist in the implementation of safety procedures and practices with new additions to maintenance and administration staff.
  • Assist in all work areas when and where needed.
  • Prepare required reports and maintain appropriate records. Oversee maintenance file system and documents.
  • Supervise and maintain the work order system for maintenance and vehicles to efficiently track work orders, conduct preventative maintenance schedules, and track/optimize equipment and vehicle reliability. Review work orders and vehicle inspections to ensure proper documentation.
  • Organize and submit work orders to ensure proper tracking of repairs and re-occurring problems. Help staff with work order tracking and reporting in the work order system.
  • Research and find information to troubleshoot and maintain vehicles, mechanical, and electrical systems.
  • Inspect work for completeness.
  • Attend meetings regarding property and grounds maintenance, development, and status.
  • Keep the supervisor informed of potential problems or unusual events.

Competencies

  • Effective communicator, both oral, written, and interpersonal ability
  • Keen ability to build and maintain prosperous relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders
  • Solutions-based leadership
  • Ethical practice
  • Proven ability to create a helpful resource development strategy
  • Goal-driven and agile in a fast-paced work environment
  • Continuous demonstration of behaviors aligned with a posture of servant leadership and our cultural values
  • Knowledge of operations, services, and activities of a building maintenance, repair, and construction program.
  • Knowledge of materials, methods, terminology, equipment, and tools used in the maintenance, repair, and construction of building structures and systems
  • Knowledge of local, state, and federal laws, ordinances, codes, and rules as these pertain to facilities maintenance

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has supervisory responsibilities and may serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the organization.

Work Environment

This job operates in a maintenance environment. This role routinely uses power tools and machines and standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets, and bend or stand on a stool as necessary.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel

Frequent travel required for program oversight

Required Education, Experience, or Eligibility Qualifications

  • High School Graduate
  • Four years of experience in maintenance, construction, or related fields

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate degree (or higher) in a related field.
  • Five years of supervisory experience

title: Onsite Medical Representative
description:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

title: Business Unit Administrator, Banking & Markets
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Role/ Department:

The Business Unit Administrator provides administrative and coordination support to the Banking & Markets (B&M) business. The role supports executive activities, governance forums, and client meetings, helping to ensure the smooth running of day-to-day business operations and the delivery of a positive experience for clients, partners, and employees.

The key responsibilities of the role include:

  • Manage diaries, travel arrangements, and expense reporting for the UK-based Banking & Markets executive team.

  • Coordinate key governance and leadership forums, including Executive Leadership Meetings, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), All Staff meetings, town halls, and leadership offsites. Partner with other admin assistants to align scheduling and ensure attendance of key stakeholders.

  • Organise and support in-person client meetings, including scheduling, room bookings, guest registration, catering, and onsite coordination. Act as host and chaperone for client visits, ensuring a professional and seamless experience.

  • Coordinate leadership visits, team events, and business engagement activities.

  • Liaise with internal partners including Security, Reception, and Catering to deliver meetings and events effectively.

  • Coordinate ad hoc information requests and the preparation of internal and external meeting materials.

  • Support onboarding activities for new joiners, including coordinating workspace, system access, induction meetings, and other administrative requirements.

  • Maintain distribution lists, the Banking & Markets Hub, and other administrative processes supporting the Banking & Markets business.

Skills/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will benefit from having:

  • Previous experience in an administrative, executive assistant, office management, or business support role.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and competing demands.

  • Excellent diary management and meeting coordination skills, including scheduling across multiple stakeholders and time zones.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver work accurately and efficiently.

  • Ability to build effective working relationships with senior leaders, colleagues, clients, and external partners.

  • Confident communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to anticipate needs and resolve issues independently.

  • Experience coordinating meetings, events, and client engagements, including managing logistics and liaising with internal support teams.

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.


Work Authorization


Applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom at the time of application and for the duration of employment.


Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. This includes Skilled Worker visas, Global Business Mobility routes, Graduate visas, Youth Mobility Scheme, High Potential Individual visas, Scale-up Worker visas, Temporary Worker visas, and other employer-sponsored visa categories.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Project Manager, Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS) Marketing Operations
description:
We are seeking a Project Manager for our Marketing Operations team in Austin, Texas, to lead the delivery of large-scale, multi-channel marketing initiatives across both Whole Foods Market and Amazon grocery brands.

This role will partner closely with Brand, Channel Marketing, and Creative teams to ensure seamless execution of complex marketing campaigns that drive customer engagement and business growth. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and embody Amazon's Leadership Principles while managing multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.

Key job responsibilities
Project Management & Execution
- Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale, multi-channel marketing initiatives for Whole Foods Market
- Manage project execution aligned with Global Marketing priorities and business objectives
- Maintain comprehensive project documentation, timelines, and status reporting
- Implement and maintain quality control processes to ensure marketing excellence

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
- Coordinate across digital channels (email, web, social, paid media) and physical channels (in-store, print) to ensure timely asset delivery and specification compliance
- Partner with creative and content teams to manage review cycles, implement feedback and ensure deliverables meet brief requirements
- Collaborate with Marketing & Ecomm program owners to ensure briefs are clear and stakeholder feedback is appropriately addressed.
- Lead regular stakeholder communications including status updates, decision documentation and risk identification.

Stakeholder Engagement & Risk Management
- Build constructive business relationships with all marketing stakeholders.
- Analyze stakeholder needs, identify gaps, assess risks, and define capabilities to identify and solve business problems effectively.
- Demonstrate effective planning and stakeholder management by setting and managing realistic project timelines.

Process Improvement
- Drive continuous improvement in marketing operations processes and workflows
- Leverage project management and AI tools (such as Workfront, Quick, Kiro) to optimize team efficiency
- Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and increase operational effectiveness
- Champion best practices in project management across the PMO



About the team
The WWGS Brand & Sustainability organization is the brand-building and differentiation engine for Amazon’s Worldwide Grocery Stores business, encompassing Whole Foods Market and Amazon Grocery. Our Marketing Operations team sits at the center of this work — we are the connective tissue between Brand, Creative, Marketing, Channel, and external agency partners, ensuring world-class creative programs launch on time, on brand, and at scale.

The Project & Resource Management team within Marketing Operations manages the end-to-end delivery of 50+ concurrent creative and marketing programs across channels including Signage, Site Merchandising, Onsite, Paid Media, Social & Influencer, and Email. We operate at the intersection of strategic planning and tactical execution, bringing order to complexity and enabling our creative teams to do their best work.

title: Audaxity Managing Director - Cancer Center
description:
Summary

Under the direction of the Director of the Medical College of Wisconsin Cancer Center (MCWCC) and the Audaxity Ride Chair (Nelson Williams), the MCWCC Annual Philanthropic Bike Ride Event Director oversees the planning, implementation, and evaluation of the fundraising and organization-wide events for the MCWCC Bike Ride. The Event Manager will work to ensure the event’s success and provide an exceptional experience for attendees, staff, and volunteers. This position will collaborate with the MCWCC Development and MCWCC Strategic Communications/Brand team to develop specific fundraising goals and annual budgets and to ensure integrated messaging and communication strategies.

Primary Responsibilities

Management

  • Oversee the execution of MCWCC’s Annual Fundraising Bike Ride to include planning and execution of the logistics; vision; budgeting; committee oversight; stewardship; and evaluation of the MCWCC Bike Race.

  • Serve as liaison between the MCWCC Director, Audaxity Ride Chair, Logistics Management Company, and Marketing Management Company to define and meet strategic goals, logistical details, manage schedules and deliverables and execute the ride to successful completion.

  • Prepare and manage the $2M Bike Race budget with philanthropic projections of up to $7M, ensuring events are meeting financial goals and expenses are within budget parameters. Work with the MCWCC Business Manager on reporting for finance.

  • Build and maintain internal relationships with MCW Foundation, MCW Central Development, MCW and MCWCC Marketing, and MCW Legal.

  • Secure significant corporate sponsorships. Collaborate with the Development Team to develop best practices and benefit packages regarding existing and prospective event sponsors.

  • Recruit, train and provide leadership and direction to the Bike Ride Staff ride recruiter, volunteers, and Board of Directors on all events via reports, meetings, and other communications.

  • Work with the MCW Foundation to ensure proper protocols are being followed.

  • Supervise ride recruiter.

  • Use data analytics to review and ensure that event strategies, goals, and intended outcomes are updated, implemented, and fit well within the overall fundraising strategies.

  • Supports the overall efforts of the MCWCC Development Team and the Central Development Office

Event Promotion and Execution

  • Manage all logistics and planning of launch parties or recruitment events throughout the year leading up to the bike ride and post-event.

  • Develop and maintain timelines and project plans to ensure each aspect of the event is on track.

  • Contact and vet vendors.

  • Act as one of the main contacts for the day-of fundraising events.

  • Manage all fundraising event timelines. Work with the logistics management company and the marketing management company to create plans that accurately reflect the department’s roles and to maintain and monitor these timelines.

  • Collaborate with the MCWCC/MCW Brand team on the messaging, marketing, and visual aspects of the event, including the media sponsorships and management of signage needs.

  • Work with marketing company and MCW Development Communications team on website – content creation, end-user experience, fundraising updates, and technical issues; brand identity; marketing materials and design; video production.

  • Collaborate with the MCWCC Communications area to provide and review copy for all event materials, including digital and print pieces.

  • In coordination with the Director of Advancement Services, implement a software solution that will facilitate registration and peer to peer fundraising activities.

  • Coordinate all electronic and print communications, content creation, graphic development related to sponsors, stakeholders, volunteers and riders

  • Manage all social media regarding the ride – Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter to maintain all MCW branding protocols.

Rider and Volunteer Recruitment

  • Identify, cultivate and recruit individual and corporate teams of riders through face to face visits and group presentations both on and off campus; goal of 1500 riders recruited.

  • Manage the Volunteer Services team to sufficiently plan for the event’s volunteer needs while facilitating positive and effective volunteer engagement.

  • Manage the MCWCC staff’s collaboration with the Donor Service team to monitor the registration process for all fundraising events including data entry, seating, list production, and acknowledgements.

  • Coordinate visits and schedules for MCWCC leadership and consultants to participate in rider recruitment efforts.

  • Manage the recruitment and training of approximately 500+ volunteers for the event.

  • Manage the organization of bike ride team meetings.

  • Field telephone and email inquiries regarding the ride.

  • Ensure every participant can successfully achieve his or her fundraising goal through training, support and encouragement.

Knowledge – Skills – Abilities

Knowledge of marketing and administration of sporting/fundraising events. Familiarity with peer to peer fundraising software and campaigns. Demonstrated ability to independently develop relationships.

Qualifications

Appropriate experience may be substituted for education on an equivalent basis.

Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree

Minimum Required Experience: 8 years

Preferred Education:

Preferred Experience: 5 + years of related event or development experience; proven fundraising success with corporate partners in a nonprofit, corporate or foundation environment; demonstrated ability to independently develop relationships; ability to work with outside volunteers/donors to manage and support peer to peer fundraising efforts; execute multiple timelines, budgets and logistics; ability to motivate people in to action; knowledge of marketing and administration of large scale sporting/fundraising events is a plus; experience with peer to peer fundraising software and campaigns

Physical Requirements

Work requires occasionally lifting moderate weight materials, standing, or walking continuously.

Work Environment

Occasional exposure to dust, noise, temperature changes, or contact with water or other liquids. Work is performed in an environmentally controlled environment.

Sensory Acuity

Ability to detect and translate speech or other communication required. May occasionally require the ability to distinguish colors and perceive relative distances between objects.

title: SUPERVISOR MANUFACTURING
description:
Job description:

SUMMARY: Supervises all warehouse staff assigned to shift, including assigning daily job tasks. Responsible for having deliveries unloaded in order of priority and properly placed in the warehouse. Responsible for keeping production supplied with components and moving finished goods from the production areas to internal and external customers. Ensures Safety and Health requirements are met for the Department. Helps to maintain 5S and housekeeping standards. Helps to maintain and ensure compliance of all related SOP’s. Performs a variety of functions related to receiving personnel and equipment maintenance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Manages all activities of assigned employees, including packing customer orders and completing all necessary shipping documentation, etc.
  • Warehouse Supervisor determines work procedures, prepares work schedules and expedites workflow; reviews and standardizes procedures to improve efficiency of subordinates
  • Directs assigned employees to tasks, ensuring they understand what is required for each shift and assigned duties
  • Provide coaching, training, and tools for employees to perform their jobs successfully. Provides feedback, when necessary, for improvement. Assists employees in resolving problems
  • Coordinates with other supervisors of preceding and succeeding shifts to ensure accurate understanding and communication of issues including full cycle carryover functions
  • Direct the operations of the assigned work team to achieve prescribed objectives
  • Follow all policies and procedures
  • Oversee the production goals established by the company and monitors to ensure employees are meeting established productivity goals, safely and accurately
  • Maintain all daily housekeeping and safety standards
  • Collaborate with workers and managers to solve work-related problems
  • Communicate via email or telephone if necessary all preventable problems to production, copying the warehouse collective email address
  • Resolve inventory issues found in empty bins
  • Counsels employees in work-related activities, personal growth, or career development
  • Recommend or initiate personnel actions, such as promotions, transfers, or disciplinary measures
  • Assess training needs of staff and arrange for or provide appropriate instruction
  • Work with Shift supervisor to keep damage area current and clean
  • Assist Line Leads in motivation to understand the necessity of meeting our customer demands and stepping forward to meet those demands
  • Routinely communicate with your Supervisor in order to gain directives, discuss decisions and action plans, and share information
  • Required to work a flexible work schedule when needed
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY REPONSIBILITIES: YES

EDUCATION:

High School Diploma/GED/or Equivalent required

Bachelor’s Degree preferred

EXPERIENCE:

Minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience required

Five (5) years of forklift experience in a narrow aisle warehouse preferred

COMPETENCIES:

  • Thorough knowledge of warehouse methods and techniques employed in a distribution center
  • Demonstrated supervisory and administrative skills
  • Demonstrated leadership and management traits including the ability to motivate people while engendering their respect and support
  • Proficient with MS Office products.
  • SAP knowledge preferred
  • Knowledge of appropriate forklift regulations and safety rules is mandatory
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to interface across the entire company
  • Train and continually develop the skills of the personnel in your area
  • Empower personnel to improve and do their best; ensuring pride in their team and ownership of their line
  • Encourage a team spirit where all associates have pride in their line, and therefore continually attempt to break records and set new production standards
  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) training, along with company pre-requisite programs, Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), and Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures (SSOP’s)
  • Problem Solving - Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work-related problems
  • Multi-tasking - Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines and handle multiple projects simultaneously and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Initiative - Ability to make decisions or take actions to solve a problem or reach a goal
  • Accuracy - Superior accuracy and attention to detail
  • Detail Oriented - Ability to pay attention to the last minute details of a project or task
  • Relationships - Establishes and maintains professional relationships with vendors, customers and employees at all levels based on credibility, integrity and trust
  • Accountability - Ability to accept responsibility and account for his/her actions
  • Honesty / Integrity - Ability to be truthful and be seen as credible in the workplace

title: Rollins Lead Instructional Coach, MLL
description:
Lead Instructional Coach

The Rollins Center for Language & Literacy at the Atlanta Speech School

The Lead Instructional Coach supports a team of Rollins coaches and leads coaching across the continuum. This role ensures the organization implements instructional and coaching practices with fidelity and consistency across sites and classrooms. The Lead Instructional Coach strengthens coaching quality by modeling effective coaching practices, providing targeted feedback, and building team capacity in language-rich instruction and adult learning.

Essential Job Duties:

In partnership with the Director of Coaching, the Lead Instructional Coach supports implementation planning, coaches new team members through onboarding, and builds strong relationships with school and partner teams to support effective collaboration. This role uses multiple data sources to guide coaching priorities, support goal setting, and adjust coaching supports based on evidence of educator practice and child outcomes.

The Lead Instructional Coach also leads team meetings and professional learning communities and leverages tools such as Cox Campus and video coaching to support ongoing learning and coherence across the team. The Lead Instructional Coach maintains a strong focus on sustainability by building partner capacity and supporting systems that promote continued implementation.

Responsibilities of the Lead Instructional Coach – Instructional Coaching and Implementation:

  • Design and facilitate professional learning opportunities for both internal teams and external partners.
  • Lead team professional learning communities (PLCs) and reflective practice meetings.
  • Support onboarding by orienting new coaching team members to tools, expectations, and shared practices.
  • Ensure coaching across teams follows an intentional, reflective coaching cycle, including goal setting, implementation, reflection, and adjustment over time.
  • Support coaches in using a gradual release approach to build facilitators’ independence over time.
  • Ensure professional learning experiences include clear purpose, practice opportunities, and reflection for transfer.
  • Support the team in using multiple data sources to prioritize needs and determine coaching focus.
  • Facilitate collaborative problem-solving by supporting the coaching team in identifying barriers and planning responsive support virtually or in-person visits.
  • Cultivate a culture of coaching and modeling strong relationship-building and coaching practices with the internal Rollins team.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Maintain clear relationship-building systems that support coordination, follow-through, and shared understanding across the coaching team.
  • Coordinate meetings with facilitators to share updates and guide strategy implementation.
  • Strengthen cross-team alignment through consistent use of shared language, expectations, and coaching tools.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Coaching to guide implementation, elevate patterns and needs from the field, and align leadership decisions to partner goals.
  • Document and communicate progress to support transparency, continuity, and decision-making.

Professional Development Facilitation:

  • Design and facilitate coaching professional development for facilitators and partners, ensuring best practices in adult learning theory are included.
  • Promote research and evidence-based practices for facilitators.
  • Analyze and compare existing coaching resources with best practices.
  • Develop redelivery content, engagement activities, and organize coaching materials for professional development.

Research/Professional Development:

  • Stay current on the latest research and best practices related to structured literacy, early childhood education, curriculum and instruction, professional learning, and instructional coaching
  • Engage in ongoing professional development to strengthen coaching practice and content expertise

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
For uncompromising cat parents who want the best, KatKin goes hardcore for cat health. We make the UK’s most popular fresh cat food: 100% human-quality meat, gently cooked, and frozen for freshness.

Where the competition cuts corners, catfishes customers and puts profits over health, we put cat wellbeing first. No shortcuts. No secret recipes. We’re cutting the fluff, thinking fresh and channelling hardcore love into industry-wide change. So cats live long and cat parents can love hard without compromise.

Having started as a two person team in 2019, founders Brett and Nikki have grown KatKin from a small startup to a leading pet-food industry disruptor kick-starting a new category of healthier cat food in the UK - “Fresh”. Our vet formulated, science backed recipes are now delivered to 60,000+ cats UK wide, and counting.

Our Direct Sales team pops up at the UKs busiest lifestyle events, railways stations, retail spaces and cat shows, delivering brand activations to connect with cat parents and share our mission of changing cats lives for the better. As our Logistics Coordinator, you’ll take ownership of making this channel bigger and better as we scale.

You’ll be in charge of making sure our activations are set up and broken down smoothly, that our assets look perfect every time, and that our stalls are fully stocked and ready to go. You’ll manage our team of freelance logistics contractors, who execute a majority of our activations (keeping them clearly briefed and acting as their main point of contact day to day), as well as setting up and breaking down key events yourself - a full, clean UK driving license is a requirement for this role.

You’ll be part of one of our fastest growing and most dynamic teams, shaking up the cat food industry for good, and making a real difference to the lives of cats and their parents.

  • Manage our logistics chain making sure we smoothly deliver the best possible experience for cat parents, event organisers, and our team of freelance Brand Ambassadors.

  • Lead our team of freelance logistics contractors, onboarding, training and briefing them clearly to ensure their work is carried out to the highest standard.

  • Develop our logistics processes, diagnosing issues and finding solutions to them.

  • Stay hands on, personally setting up and breaking down events across the UK (full, clean UK driving license required).

  • Maintain assets keeping the KatKin brand looking as slick as possible at every activation.

  • Manage stock across all of our activations, keeping us ready to go throughout the year.

  • Experienced - you have a background in logistics.

  • Detail oriented and process driven - you have high standards, and are driven to execute each event perfectly, making sure logistics processes run smoothly.

  • Self starter - you relish a challenge, and always find a way around obstacles.

  • Organised - you’re a multi-tasker, who delivers on deadlines.

  • People person - you love people, and want to help train and nurture them to thrive.

  • Problem solver - you jump on problems, and have a plan to solve them.

  • Dynamic - you thrive in a fast paced, evolving team environment.

  • A full, clean UK driving license is a requirement.

  • Competitive salary

  • Extensive growth opportunities in a fast paced, VC backed scale up

  • No egos and a small close-knit team

  • Regular team & company socials, team lunch on Mondays provided

  • Discount on KatKin products for your cat, and £500 for new cat parents

  • £800 yearly personal development budget
