title: Production TPM, AMZ Leo Production OPs
description:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
To deliver these complex solutions, as the Sr Operations Program Manager you will partner with peers across all Leo teams, including hardware, software, supply chain, manufacturing, launch, facilities, finance, compliance, and HR.

This role includes direct responsibility for program management of system level development, integration, and test of production value stream. This is a highly technical role requiring experience with data analytics, data modeling, integrated hardware and software as well as some appreciation for complex applications and manufacturing systems.

Candidate superpowers should include ownership, insist on high standards, stakeholder management, influencing without authority, innovation, creating clarity out of ambiguity, and enabling productive collaboration.



Key job responsibilities
- Own the production roadmap for production value streams that delivers the end-to-end solutions necessary to source, build, test and integrate satellites.
- Establish the linkage between production roadmap and annual goals & objectives, creating data models, owning tools and mechanisms to measure, monitor and optimize these value streams.
- Drive daily execution working across supply chain, planning, fulfillment and production teams.
- Represent the overall production roadmap in assessing technical trades related to innovation, speed, manufacturability, cost, stability and trust.
- Translate strategic goals into actionable plans for specific projects and operations.
- Understand dependencies between roadmap projects, synchronize milestones, identify constraints and dive deep where necessary to unblock and deliver the roadmap.
- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.
- Develop and own operational rhythms for all of production operations teams
- Identify potential risks in manufacturing processes and develop mitigation strategies and recovery plans.
- Execute a strategic plan that defines how teams will deliver on forward looking production plans.
- Support the development and execution of Production Rate Ramp roadmaps.
- Partner with business teams on scalable, standardized approaches to meet their demand and enable growth.
- Drive the creation, documentation, and adoption of scalable, standardized, and highly visible processes across all supply chain, manufacturing and launch functions.
- Drive executive communication cadence and deliver artifacts that provide insight into the activities, accomplishments, challenges and risks of operations to senior leadership.
- Measure, analyze, improve, and control KPIs across all aspects of the operation.
- Work with software and analytics teams to develop reporting tools and applications that support, operating rhythms
- Analyze production data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
- Support implementation training on new processes or improvements identified through PDCA cycles
- Drive year over year optimization opportunities in all areas of operations, including manufacturing and sourcing.
- Provide feedback/escalate systemic concerns to tech teams regarding approaches that are cost-inefficient or detrimental to scaling.
- Advices production directors and sr. managers on technology and execution decisions.
- Unblocks production teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities across different technology stakeholders.
- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.
- Ensure effective communication of changes and improvements across the organization.
- Perform internal audits to assess adherence to procedures, systems and standards.


A day in the life
This role will be highly collaborative, requiring partnerships with cross-functional production stakeholders to drive positive results. This role requires the ability to advocate on behalf of our customers (internal and external) and an ability to push back without being adversarial.

This role will be supporting production of satellite operations across our facilities in Redmond and Kirkland, WA. A typical day for this role will be working directly with production teams and value stream owners on plan execution and check process adherence. Throughout the day, an Sr. Operations TPM for satellite manufacturing must balance strategic planning with hands-on oversight of project execution. Communication skills are crucial, as they interact with various stakeholders including customers, suppliers, and internal teams. The role requires strong leadership to motivate and coordinate teams towards achieving project goals while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and adherence to timelines.

Overall, the role demands strategic thinking, effective leadership, and meticulous oversight to drive satellite manufacturing projects forward successfully. This role will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.


About the team
Project Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. title: Senior AWS Data Engineer
description:
Overview

Lead AWS Data Engineer

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Lead AWS Data Engineer to join a data enablement and AI-focused initiative supporting a leading global institutional investment organization. The role will be responsible for designing and implementing secure, scalable, and governed AWS data solutions, with a strong focus on modern data lake technologies, fine-grained data access controls, and enterprise data engineering best practices. The successful candidate will work closely with data, cloud, and AI teams to deliver reliable data platforms that support critical investment and business functions

Primary Location: New York City/ Toronto

Work Model: Hybrid – 3-Days Onsite

Employment Type: Contract – 3 Months

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data engineering solutions on AWS
  • Build and manage data lakes using AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Apache Iceberg, and Amazon Athena
  • Implement fine-grained data access controls including LF-Tags, row-level security, column-level security, and data filtering
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain data processing pipelines using Python and PySpark
  • Write complex and efficient SQL queries for data transformation, analysis, and validation
  • Configure and manage Amazon Athena Workgroups and related data access mechanisms
  • Use Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management following Infrastructure-as-Code best practices
  • Collaborate with data, cloud, and AI teams to deliver secure and reliable enterprise data solutions
  • Apply best practices for data governance, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data platforms and pipelines to ensure reliability and performance

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS data solutions
  • Strong experience with AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, and Amazon Athena
  • Hands-on experience building and managing modern cloud-based data lakes
  • Strong knowledge of Apache Iceberg and modern data lake architectures
  • Demonstrated experience implementing fine-grained data access controls, including LF-Tags, row-level security, column-level security, and data filtering
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex data transformation and analytical queries
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Athena Workgroups and data access mechanisms
  • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, and governed enterprise data platforms
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, performance, and maintainability best practices
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineering, cloud, AI, and other cross-functional teams

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working in financial services, investment management, or other highly regulated enterprise environments
  • Experience supporting data and AI-focused initiatives
  • Experience with additional AWS analytics and data services
  • Experience working with enterprise data governance frameworks
  • Previous experience in a technical lead or senior engineering capacity

ABOUT ADASTRA

Adastra is a global leader in AI and data-driven transformation, helping organizations lead with artificial intelligence—responsibly, strategically, and at scale. With over 25 years of experience, Adastra empowers enterprise clients to unlock business value through data innovation, operational excellence, and smart customer engagement.

Trusted by some of the world’s most prominent brands, Adastra delivers end-to-end solutions grounded in thoughtful strategy, robust governance, and deep technical expertise. From defining vision to ensuring execution, Adastra guides organizations through every stage of their AI, data and cloud journey—building future-ready capabilities and delivering measurable, lasting impact.

Adastra serves clients across key industries including financial services, automotive, manufacturing, technology, media and telecom (TMT), healthcare, retail, and professional services. The company employs more than 2,000 professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Successful referral program
  • The opportunity to work with one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies
  • Satisfaction of working for a reputable company
  • A flexible, dynamic, and diverse workplace

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

In our commitment to promote fair and equitable treatment of all employees and applicants, Adastra Corporation provides equal employment opportunities for all individuals regardless of age, sex, disability, race, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other ground as described in the Ontario Human Rights Code. In addition, accommodation will be provided during the hiring process. title: State Relations Coordinator
description:
Department Information

To apply, please go to:

Join Our Team and Make a Difference in Higher Education!

At the System Administration office at the University of Colorado, we are dedicated to building a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Our office is committed to fostering a culture where employees find community, a sense of belonging, and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission and purpose.

By joining our team, you’ll have a direct impact on shaping the future of higher education. In addition to the Office of the Board of Regents, the University of Colorado’s system administration includes 19 units that provide essential services to CU’s campuses in Aurora, Boulder, Colorado Springs, and Denver, as well as the Office of the President. While not a part of any one campus, we are proud to serve in the centralized office for the University system. Together, we ensure CU continues to deliver outstanding education, groundbreaking research, and valuable service to our communities.

We believe in creating an environment where the unique experiences and perspectives of everyone are embraced, enriching the work we do and the strategic outcomes we pursue. If you’re passionate about making a difference, contributing to a dynamic team, and supporting a mission that matters, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey. Learn more about CU System Administration.

Position Summary:

The missions of the Office of Government Relations are to support the University's efforts of building effective relationships between the University and the State and Federal governments.

The State Relations Coordinator supports the University's state government relations strategy through legislative research and analysis, stakeholder engagement, constituent response, legislative and election tracking, event and outreach coordination, and operational management. The position independently coordinates assigned state relations activities.

Where You Will Work:

This role is eligible for a hybrid schedule, working some days from home and some days in the office at 1800 Grant St, Denver, CO. Please note that from the months of January through May, this role requires full-time in-office attendance.

Description of Job

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supports the state legislative session through legislative research, development of legislator profiles and briefing materials, and maintenance of legislative databases and contact information; responds to research and information requests to support the state relations team;
  • Works with the Senior Director of State Relations to research, analyze, and report upon a wide-range of legislative policy and procedural matters, synthesizes information and develops materials both in the normal course of business, and in response to requests from the VP, Senior Director, university constituencies, and Government officials, as appropriate;
  • Serves as back-up to the Senior Director of State Relations on bill tracking during the legislative session;
  • Under the supervision of the Senior Director of State Relations, prepares reports and notes while covering and representing the University at committee hearings and meetings when necessary;
  • Coordinates with VP and Senior Director of State Relations on the development of invitation lists for campus events and outreach meetings for legislators attendance;
  • Works with the Senior Director of State Relations on election coverage by tracking primary and general election results, drafting update reports and elected official biographies for use by Regents, System Administration and Chancellors;
  • Manages the scheduling of meetings, updating calendars and preparing corresponding materials for VP of State Relations, Senior Director of State Relations, and Senior Advisors for State Relations & Public Policy;
  • Provides logistical support for meetings, tours and events including assisting with securing parking, food, and venues; sending invitations, collecting RSVP's and staffing select events; preparing thank you letters, and assisting with other items as needed for the success of the specific event;
  • Manages travel arrangements for State Relations team including preparing itineraries and expense reimbursement reports and making travel reservations;
  • Supports operations for Denver office, including office budgets, contracts, and travel; approves A-card transactions; coordinates payment of bills in a timely manner, and under supervision of Senior Director of State Relations, helps to manage relationship with building management including safety issues, lease issues, and suite maintenance;
  • Assists with a variety of duties including filing; purchasing supplies; preparing expense system reports, making deliveries and attending meetings that are relevant to the position;
  • Drafts a variety of documents including correspondence, emails and reports, including assisting the Senior Director of State Relations on preparing the department’s newsletter for the state team;
  • Assists with special projects including regent outreach activities and others as they arise;
  • Manages the state team’s social media accounts, including developing and coordinating content that supports the department's communication and engagement priorities;
  • Works to coordinate strategic coverage of events and meetings for the department;
  • Works with Senior Director of State Relations to resolve constituent requests from legislators regarding issues on campuses;
  • Oversees the maintenance of office tracking spreadsheets and databases;
  • Supports Senior Director of State Relations in managing football invitations and ticketing for state elected officials and congressional members, as well as invoicing and receipt of monies for their purchased tickets;
  • Oversees the systematic relationship building and coverage of internal constituencies;

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience substituted on a year-for-year basis.
  • One (1) year of office experience in higher education, government, or related work environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A relevant graduate degree or coursework.
  • Two (2) years of related experience.
  • Experience working in Government Relations in a higher education institution.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Self-starter with good judgment and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Team player with strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.
  • Able to multi-task and prioritize work accordingly to meet deadlines while staying on task with daily assignments.
  • Possess advanced computer skills using Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and ages

Supplemental Information

How to Apply:

For full consideration, please attach the following as separate documents to your application at :

  1. A cover letter identifying the job specific minimum qualifications you possess and interest in the position.
  2. A resume including all relevant experience to be accurately assessed against the qualifications listed in the posting.

Benefits:

With our unparalleled range of benefits, including top-notch healthcare, comprehensive wellness programs, enriching professional development, and a dynamic work-life balance, we ensure your holistic growth and happiness.

  • No-cost or low-cost medical & dental plan options, some inclusive of IVF assistance.

  • Disability, Life, Vision Insurance options.

  • Multiple retirement planning options including a mandatory 401(a) plan where CU contributes 10% of your gross pay, a 401k or 403b plan and a 457 deferred compensation plan.

  • Pre-tax savings plans, such as Health care and Dependent care flexible spending accounts.

  • Embrace a healthy work-life balance with ample sick and vacation leave, along with at least 12 paid holidays. This includes a dedicated week off for winter break.

  • 6 weeks of parental leave to adjust to the joys of parenthood.

  • A tuition benefit program for you and/or your dependents.

  • Free RTD EcoPass and free onsite parking at our 1800 Grant Street Office.

  • Many additional perks & programs with the CU Advantage.

Additional taxable fringe benefits may be available.

For more information on benefits programs, please review our Comprehensive Benefits Guide.

Access our Total Compensation Calculator to see what your total rewards could be at CU. (This position is a University Staff position)

title: Assistive Technology Specialist - Special Education
description:
Primary Purpose:

Coordinate and manage district instructional programs to meet the needs of students served through special education with assistive technology needs. Serve as instructional leader in development and improvement of programs, supports and accommodations provided. Collaborate with district staff and outside personnel to formulate, develop, implement, and evaluate research-based interventions in Special Education. Provide Assistive Technology services to eligible students and support education professionals to enable special education students to access their educational process as independently as possible.

Education / Certification:

  1. Master’s degree from an accredited college or university preferred.
  2. Valid Texas Principal or other appropriate Texas certificate and/or experience preferred.
  3. Assistive Technology background and/or certificate preferred

Experience / Other Requirements

  1. Three years of teaching experience or equivalent special education experience is required.

Special Knowledge / Skills:

  1. Knowledge of curriculum and instruction.
  2. Knowledge of special education programs, regulations, and specific areas of disability.
  3. Knowledge/familiarization of Assistive Technology devices, services, regulations and procedures relating to IDEA/Federal/State mandates.
  4. Ability to interpret individual assessment data (FIE) with regards to program planning and implementation.
  5. Ability to evaluate program effectiveness; program compliance.
  6. Ability to interpret policy, procedures, and data.
  7. Strong organizational, communication, public relations, and interpersonal skills.
  8. Ability to establish and maintain relationships with CISD, other districts, state and federal agency personnel who are involved with the research, administration, and coordination of special education programs.

Major Responsibilities and Duties:

Instructional Management

  1. Provides continuous and systematic procedures for professional growth for classroom teachers through workshops and demonstrations pertinent to methods and materials that will ensure success for students served in special education with assistive technology needs.
  2. Consults frequently with classroom teachers on matters relating to instruction.
  3. Recommends adoption and use of varied instructional materials.
  4. Assists building principals and other administrators and/or supervisors in implementing the instructional program.
  5. Assists in the evaluation of ongoing programs and makes recommendations for changes.
  6. Works as a resource person for teachers regarding assistive technology.
  7. Helps teachers to diagnose student strengths and weaknesses and to match these skills with appropriate techniques, materials, and/or technology.
  8. Works with school support staff and school administrators to facilitate the coordination of programs for students with assistive technology needs.
  9. Coordinates and/or provides in-home training services as specified in a student’s IEP.
  10. Attends appropriate professional meetings and workshops to maintain proficiency and acquire new ideas for instructional improvement. Informs administration of the effects of current and impending legislation.

Assistive Technology

  1. Develop/implement Assistive Technology procedures and guidelines.
  2. Develop process to implement and monitor Assistive Technology services/devices for eligible students.
  3. Develop/maintain Assistive Technology Lending Library for district wide use.
  4. Provide in-services/workshops and/or consultation to district personnel, students, families on Assistive Technology guidelines, programs, devices/modifications, evaluations, and data collection.
  5. Develop/implement/monitor campus and district-based assistive technology teams
  6. Conduct/Review Assistive Technology assessment as needed when requested by ARD committee.
  7. Interface with manufacturer for obtaining/training of devices.
  8. Coordinate with Special Education Director for funding of Assistive Technology.
  9. Provide technical assistance/collaboration of devices to campus staff.
  10. Consultation with parent(s) in use and applicability of Assistive Technology.
  11. Collaboration with assessment personnel pertaining to Assistive Technology consideration as part of the ARD process.
  12. Assist student/teachers/therapists to utilize Assistive Technology in the educational process.
  13. Maintain and submit, as requested, student assessment files, reports, data collection materials.
  14. Train students on operation and use of Assistive Technology devices.

Policy, Reports, and Law

  1. Comply with policies established by federal and state law, Commissioner’s Rules, and local board policy.
  2. Effectively communicate with the purposes and progress of the instructional program(s) with colleagues, students, and parents.
  3. Participate in professional development activities to improve skills related to job assignment.
  4. Responsible for properly maintaining district records, adhering to all policies set forth by the district for records maintenance and learning the records retention schedule for department records.
  5. Orients beginning teachers, aides and school volunteer aides as to the philosophy, procedures and materials for the instructional program.
  6. Compiles, maintains, and files all physical and computerized reports, records, and other documents required.
  7. Assists administration in the resolution of parent concerns and complaints with regards to
  8. Special Education programming. Demonstrates awareness of district-community needs and initiates activities to meet needs.
  9. Performs additional tasks and duties as assigned.

title: Part Time Supervisor, Calvin Klein Lifestyle - Bluewater
description:
Be part of an iconic story.

At Calvin Klein, we believe in fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture by celebrating different perspectives, backgrounds and beliefs to truly connect with our associates and consumers. Join us and have a meaningful impact on the world – and – endless opportunities to design your future. Immerse yourself in Calvin Klein here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)

Calvin Klein is a global lifestyle brand that exemplifies bold, progressive ideals and a seductive, and often minimal, aesthetic. We seek to thrill and inspire our audience while using provocative imagery and striking designs to ignite the senses.

After nearly 50 years, Calvin Klein continues to be a cultural catalyst across the globe by embracing tension, sparking ideas and creating unforeseen realities. We believe in a culture that provokes discovery and brave thinking. We strive to make a positive impact on the world. We inspire passion in our people. We embody authenticity and embrace individuality.

Founded in 1968 by Calvin Klein and his business partner Barry Schwartz, we have built our reputation as a leader in American fashion through our clean aesthetic and innovative designs. Global retail sales of Calvin Klein brand products exceeded $8 billion in 2015 and were distributed in [over] 110 countries. Calvin Klein employs over 10,000 associates globally. We were acquired by PVH Corp. in 2003.

About THE ROLE

Our stores are the life and soul of our business. They act as our main touch points with our ever evolving consumer base. As the world of retail evolves, we, as a business, believe that for all other parts of the chain to work, our stores must set the tone of what our two brands are all about. Irrespective of where our consumers eventually make a purchase, our stores, are always a window to our great brands. As a result our locations are paramount, the first class experience must be a given and our in-store standards should never be questionable.

To deliver this, we strive to hire the individuals who live and breathe the values of our business; who are obsessed with delivering great service to our customers and who truly believe that to remain relevant in today’s world, we must be nimble and adapt to change and evolution.

The Supervisor plays a key role in achieving these standards, they lead by example, embrace our entrepreneurial spirit and inspire their teams through their passion and belief in our brands.

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensure the efficient running of the shop floor, in order to achieve the highest levels of customer service, sales and profit.

  • Support the management team managing all personnel, product & merchandising functions, business processes and results for the store.

  • Participate in weekly management meetings and other staff meetings.

  • Clearly communicate to staff all marketing and sales promotions.

  • Driving shop floor sales and exceeding store targets through motivating the team to achieve these goals, whilst offering our customers’ an exemplary store journey.

  • Consistently foster a positive store experience by treating all customers and colleagues in a fair and consistent manner.

  • Support the team in delivering the business strategy, and ensuring everyone has received consistent training on product knowledge and store maintenance.

  • Achieve company standards/goals for personal sales results: sales v budgets, sales per hour and units per transaction.

  • Perform manager-on-duty functions, manage store opening/closing functions and the sales floor.

  • Focus staff on the importance of quality relationships with internal and external customers.

  • Ensure staff accountability of building a repeat customer base by providing all customers with unparalleled spirited service.

  • Ensure “door to floor” best practices with visual merchandising directives for sales floor and back room are being executed; continually review these to ensure they are consistent.

  • Work with the management team to build a talent pool for key positions, including possible successors.

About YOU

  • You'll have a previous track record of supervisory or specialist roles within a premium or luxury brand.

  • You'll have previous people management experience with the ability to resolve conflict and unproductive disagreements.

  • You'll be an effective communicator with the ability to build relationships with ease.

  • You'll be a team player who recognises and celebrates the contributions and achievements of others.

  • You'll be confident in giving feedback that promotes positive behavioral change.

  • You will work well with change, being able to quickly adapt and work with pace.

  • You will be energetic and authentic showing a clear presence on the shop floor.

  • You'll approach all issues with a ‘can do’ approach and act with initiative to find in store solutions.

About WHAT WE OFFER

At PVH, we understand that the success of our organisation is directly related to our hardworking and dedicated associates who contribute their time and talents to help make our Company the success it is. That is why we are committed to providing a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that offers the protection, peace of mind and flexibility designed to support our associates – both at home and at work.

PVH Europe and our brands, TOMMY HILFIGER and CALVIN KLEIN, are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. We believe we are bettered by all forms of diversity, and take pride in working with top talent from every walk of life and corner of the world. In the spirit of inclusivity, qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, ability, gender, gender expression, gender identity, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation.

About PVH:

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.

One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (all genders)
description:
reev is building the Energy Hub for EV charging and energy management across Europe - the platform that companies, operators, and drivers use every day to run their charging and energy infrastructure.
We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build and evolve one of the core areas of the reev platform. You'll work across the stack, take ownership of meaningful product areas end-to-end, and help shape how we deliver value to operators and drivers across Europe.

What You'll Do

Our stack is Kotlin on the backend, React for the reev hub, React Native for the driver apps, all running on AWS. You'll work across all of it, closely with your PM and designers.
  • Design, build, and ship features across backend, web, and mobile that operators and drivers rely on daily.
  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through rollout and continuous improvement.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions with customer and business impact in mind.
  • Raise the bar on quality, reliability, performance, and security through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping fullstack products.
  • Solid experience across frontend and backend. Kotlin, React, React Native, and AWS are our stack; equivalent JVM, TypeScript, and cloud experience is welcome.
  • A product mindset: you stay close to users, maket houghtful trade-offs, and use feedback to improve what you build.
  • Care for engineering quality - testing, observability, maintainability, and the day-to-day experience of the people using your software.
  • Comfort using AI tools daily to think, prototype, and unblock yourself.
  • Clear communication in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Bonus: experience in B2B SaaS, energy, or mobility.
How we work
Clear goals. Real ownership. No politics. We move fast, decide together, and hold each other accountable - because progress beats perfection. Monthly team events and regular cross-office collaboration between Munich and Zagreb keep us connected as one team.

Where you'll work
Our office at Stiglmaierplatz is where collaboration happens - in person, direct, eye to eye. For this role, we expect you on-site at least three days per week, because great things happen when you're in the same room.

What You Get
  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget - Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fine print.
Benefits may vary slightly by location.

title: Cybersecurity Compliance Coordinator SY26-27
description:
The Town of Needham and Needham Pubic Schools seeks a creative and collaborative an Cybersecurity Compliance Coordinator.

About Needham Public Schools (NPS): NPS has a deep commitment to the success of our diverse students and families and to the professional accomplishments of its educators. Needham devotes itself to cultural proficiency, equity, and community collaboration to fulfill the vision of the Portrait of a Needham Graduate. This METCO district comprises 5 elementary schools, 2 middle schools, and 1 nationally-ranked high school serving approximately 5,500 students. NPS is committed to addressing equity in the district by focusing on improving academic performance for historically marginalized students and ensuring our schools are safe for every child and free of bias, bullying, and hurtful acts that demean and diminish. Read more about our equity work here.

Under the direction of the Enterprise Applications Manager,plays a vital role in protecting the digital assets, data, and infrastructure of both the Town of Needham and Needham Public Schools. Rather than focusing on hands-on technical engineering, this position focuses on the governance, risk, compliance and project management side of cybersecurity. This position is responsible for coordinating cybersecurity programs, maintaining security policies and procedures, supporting incident response activities, promoting cybersecurity awareness, and assisting departments in improving security practices across municipal and school operations.

The role serves as a central point of coordination for cybersecurity governance and operational readiness, working collaboratively with IT staff, school administrators, municipal departments, vendors, and external partners. This is a full time in-person position with occasional remote work capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Governance & Compliance

  • Develop, maintain, and update cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Assist with implementation and tracking of cybersecurity best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate periodic cybersecurity assessments and audits.
  • Maintain inventories of systems, applications, technology assets, and associated cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Track remediation efforts and work with IT staff and vendors to address identified vulnerabilities.

Security Awareness & Training

  • Coordinate cybersecurity awareness and training programs for town and school staff.
  • Develop educational materials and communications related to cybersecurity best practices, phishing awareness, password security, and data protection and provide end user training.
  • Support phishing simulation and user awareness initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of cybersecurity awareness across all departments.

Incident Response & Risk Management

  • Coordinate cybersecurity incident response activities and documentation.
  • Provide end user support for cybersecurity incidents.
  • Assist in investigation, tracking, escalation, and resolution of security incidents.
  • Maintain incident response procedures and reporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with internal stakeholders and external partners during security incidents as appropriate.
  • Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning efforts.

Program Coordination & Administration

  • Serve as a liaison between IT staff, departments, school personnel, vendors, and external cybersecurity resources.
  • Provide guidance and recommendations to municipal and school department leaders and boards regarding security protocols and emerging digital threats.
  • Assess and monitor third-party vendor cybersecurity risks.
  • Assist with cybersecurity-related projects and initiatives.
  • Maintain records, reports, metrics, and dashboards related to cybersecurity activities and program effectiveness.
  • Monitor emerging cybersecurity risks and communicate relevant information to leadership and staff.
  • Participate in technology planning and security-related meetings.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Public Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience in IT coordination, cybersecurity administration, compliance, project management, or related technology support roles preferred.
  • Experience in a municipal government, K–12 education, or public-sector environment is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and information security best practices.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical and cybersecurity concepts to non-technical users.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, vulnerability management, and incident response processes.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across departments.
  • Proficiency with standard business and IT productivity tools.
  • Ability to stay up-to-date technically and apply new knowledge to the job. Includes adapting to and mastering new applications and processes implemented by the department.
  • Ability to respond to urgent calls on a 24/7 basis and to work off-hours shifts.
  • Ability to follow policy and procedures.
  • Ability to engage in effective communication, collaboration, and teamwork with individuals from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives, while demonstrating respect for their differences.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Customer service-oriented mindset.

Supervision Received:

Works independently, reporting to the Enterprise Applications Manager.

Supervision Exercised:

No direct supervision, although works with a variety of school employees from all organizational levels and departments.

Job Environment:

Works in a typical office environment, with moderate noise and occasional interruptions.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to work at a desk; regularly convey information to staff, vendors, and the public; regularly move about inside the office to access file cabinets and office machinery; and traverse stairs. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move objects weighing up to 10 pounds, such as supplies, folders, and books. Ability to operate a keyboard at efficient speed and to view computer screens for extended periods of time. Operates motor vehicles. Ability to operate standard office equipment.

(This job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.)

Work Year:

This position has a work year of 260 days, at 8 hours per day. In person work with occasional remote capabilities if authorized by supervisor.

Salary Information:

FLSA: Exempt

Salary is determined by experience, Grade J ranging from $114,609.63- $131,042.38

De RHA heeft een divers opleidingsaanbod voor verschillende doelgroepen: artsen, medisch specialisten, verpleegkundigen, paramedici en onderzoekers. Binnen de Radboudumc Health Academy komen professionals al tijdens de opleiding met elkaar in contact en worden vanuit één gedachte opgeleid. We geloven in continue professionele ontwikkeling van zorgprofessionals en daar hoort een leven lang leren bij om patiënten dagelijks de beste zorg te kunnen bieden.

De Radboudumc Health Academy wil het verschil maken in de zorg door te investeren in het opleiden van zorgprofessionals – voor nu en voor de toekomst. Goed onderwijs is de basis voor goede zorg. Daarom zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor het versterken en vernieuwen.

Profiel

Ben je betrouwbaar en wil je beschikbaar zijn om tijdens de vaardighedentoetsen van de bachelor Geneeskunde door studenten onderzocht te worden?

In het kader van ons onderzoek, vragen wij alleen als proefpersoon te reageren indien je aan onderstaand profiel voldoet. Anders heeft reageren helaas geen zin.

  • Voorkeursleeftijd 18 tot 65 jaar.
  • Je studeert geen geneeskunde.
  • Je hebt geen lopend contract bij het Radboudumc.
  • Je bent bereid om ingezet te worden bij alle onderzoeken.
  • Je hebt geen problemen met aanraking door een student, onder toezicht van een arts-docent.
  • Je bent flexibel beschikbaar, met een piek in december/januari.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal.

Medische voorgeschiedenis:

  • Geen of goed ingestelde hoge bloeddruk.
  • Geen bekende forse afwijkingen in vorm borstkas .
  • Zicht en gehoor adequaat (eventueel met hulpmiddelen).
  • Geen bekende hartritmestoornissen.

Mobiliteit:

  • Lopen zonder hulpmiddelen en geen moeite met positieveranderingen.

Goed om te weten

  • Er zal een gesprek plaatsvinden en een lichamelijk onderzoek waarin arts - docenten bekijken of je in aanmerking kan komen als proefpersoon. Aanname kan alleen plaatsvinden na een positief gesprek en lichamelijk onderzoek.
  • Inzet is flexibel, voor een aantal dagdelen per jaar (tijdens kantooruren) met een vaste vergoeding van 10 euro per uur.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op donderdag 17 september tussen 13.00 – 17.00 en op donderdag 24 september tussen 12.00 – 17.00. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt. Geef eventueel je beschikbaarheid aan in je motivatiebrief.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: PreArrival Associate - IM Radiology - FT Days (62725)
description:
Job Summary: Responsible for facilitating patient access for services at Maryville Imaging, LLC by accurately and efficiently verifying patient insurance eligibility and obtaining any appropriate pre-certifications or medical necessity prior to the patient receiving scheduled or non-scheduled services and then completing the pre-registration for the patient visit. This position is responsible for communicating to the Financial Clearance Associate any patients that will be presenting without insurance for further assistance. This position is responsible for providing excellent customer service when communicating with patients while also protecting the privacy of the patient’s health information. This position will also perform as backup to the Financial Clearance Associate as needed.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  1. Obtains patient personal information and pertinent insurance information to accurately verify insurance eligibility, pre-certification information, financial obligations and medical necessity prior to creating the patient pre-registration. Utilizes appropriate strategies, including phone calls and online databases to verify the insurance coverage of scheduled patients. Obtains benefit information such as deductible, co-payment and co-insurance amounts.
  2. Collaborates with the physician offices to obtain any pre-certification information prior to the day of service and documents this information in patient record in the registration system. This includes obtaining additional an additional diagnosis when a test does not pass medical necessity.
  3. Communicates with the Financial Clearance Associate any financial obligations due that need to be communicated to the patient prior to the day of service and any patients that do not have insurance and require financial counseling so that the patient is advised prior to the day of service what their financial obligations will be at the time of service.
  4. Communicates with the physician offices when the patient does not present with a valid order and identifies to the physician office what is needed to be re-sent to the imagining center so that the patient can receive the services.
  5. Identifies when a physician is not in the registration physician dictionary and forwards that physician information to HIM to be added accordingly.
  6. Coordinates the pre-registrations for the day of service for the patient access staff.
  7. Assists the Patient Access staff with add-on or walk-in patients, determining if testing needs pre-certification and making phone calls to verify coverage. Counsels walk in patients when needed regarding financial assistance.
  8. Performs quality improvements to records as indicated by the quality improvement tool (RQi) in a timely and efficient manner.
  9. Performs other miscellaneous assignments and/or duties as related to the position.

Other miscellaneous assignments and/or duties as related to this position:

Assists and performs as backup to the Financial Clearance Associate functions and responsibilities i.e. determining patient insurance eligibility, reviewing medical necessity, obtaining insurance pre-certifications from physician offices and/or creating pre-registrations as needed.

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Game, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
description:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người đặt nền móng cho đà tăng trưởng có chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, giành chiến thắng nhờ giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động để chứng minh sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác.

Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ là đối tác chiến lược và cố vấn đáng tin cậy cho các nhà phát triển trò chơi và ứng dụng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam, giúp họ mở rộng quy mô và thành công trên trường quốc tế. Bạn sẽ quản lý và thắt chặt các mối quan hệ ở cấp điều hành, định hình cách Google hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ này trên toàn cầu.

Nhiệm vụ cốt lõi của bạn là thúc đẩy tăng trưởng kinh doanh cho khách hàng bằng cách tận dụng Chiến dịch quảng cáo ứng dụng và Hệ sinh thái ứng dụng của Google, đồng thời khai thác các cơ hội đổi mới giữa các sản phẩm để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh vượt trội và có thể đo lường.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

  • Tương tác và tạo sức ảnh hưởng đến những người ra quyết định chủ chốt, bao gồm cả ban lãnh đạo cấp cao, xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy để thấu hiểu các thách thức cốt lõi và ưu tiên chiến lược trong hoạt động kinh doanh của họ.
  • Dẫn dắt quá trình phát triển kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, thống nhất với khách hàng về các mục tiêu đầy tham vọng và xác lập trách nhiệm chung để mở ra các cơ hội tăng trưởng mang tính đột phá.
  • Thiết kế và thuyết trình về các giải pháp mạnh mẽ, dựa trên dữ liệu của Google được điều chỉnh theo nhu cầu của khách hàng, tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và cách kể chuyện lôi cuốn, đồng thời xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều để thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh số.
  • Thể hiện rõ giá trị của Google bằng cách đối chiếu kết quả chiến dịch so với mục tiêu của khách hàng và giải pháp của đối thủ cạnh tranh, đồng thời chia sẻ thông tin chi tiết dựa trên dữ liệu để định hình chiến lược của khách hàng và củng cố mối quan hệ đối tác.
  • Chịu trách nhiệm thúc đẩy đà tăng trưởng của khách hàng bằng cách chủ động xác định và phát triển nguồn cơ hội mới dồi dào, tận dụng thông tin chi tiết và thành công đã được chứng minh để mở rộng mối quan hệ đối tác.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, tư vấn bán hàng, phát triển kinh doanh hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để phục vụ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong ngành trò chơi/ứng dụng, truyền thông, phát triển kinh doanh, tiếp thị hoặc tư vấn bán hàng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm và đạt được thành công trong việc phát triển và duy trì những khách hàng được quản lý có giá trị cao, phức tạp theo hướng chiến lược thông qua phương pháp tư vấn.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Có khả năng vận dụng những cách tiếp cận sáng tạo để phát triển giải pháp qua dữ liệu.
  • Có kỹ năng tổ chức, giải quyết vấn đề, tạo sự ảnh hưởng và thuyết trình xuất sắc.

title: Systems Development Engineer, AWS Generative AI & ML Servers
description:
Do you want to build the backbone of Generative AI at AWS? Do you want to build the future of the cloud for AI training and inference, delivering continuous price performance improvements for multi-billion variable LLMs at cloud scale? Come join us. We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer to develop automation software, diagnostic tooling, and fleet health infrastructure for our accelerated (AI/ML) server platforms. You will work across multiple teams and organizations to build scalable, reliable systems that keep our fleet healthy — with a vision toward zero-touch operations where automation detects, diagnoses, and resolves issues without human intervention.

What You Will Do
You will solve complex architectural problems that may not be well-defined in advance. You will own your team's systems, proactively identify deficiencies, and write scalable, robust code to solve issues before they impact customers. You will decompose large, difficult server testability, reliability, and diagnosis problems into straightforward tasks and components — delivering yourself and through others in parallel — using a combination of hardware, software, system design, processor architecture, diagnostics, and operations knowledge.

Key job responsibilities
Fleet Health & Predictive Infrastructure

1. Build and own the automation infrastructure responsible for the health of the accelerator (AI/ML) compute server fleet
2. Design and implement predictive failure detection systems using telemetry, sensor data, error trending, and log correlation to identify hardware issues before they cause customer impact
3. Drive toward zero-touch operations — building automation that detects, diagnoses, triages, and remediates hardware and software faults without human intervention
4. Develop monitoring tools, dashboards, and alerting systems to provide real-time visibility into fleet health across lab and production environments
5. Define and track fleet health metrics (failure rates, mean time to detect, mean time to repair, first-time fix rate, predictive accuracy)

Debugging & Troubleshooting

1. Debug and resolve complex system-level issues across compute, GPU, and networking in production environments
2. Troubleshoot Linux boot and runtime failures across x86 and ARM architectures, including PCIe, power, NIC, NVMe, and GPU subsystems
3. Perform root cause analysis on hardware failures — correlating across firmware, kernel, driver, and physical layer to isolate faults
4. Build diagnostic tooling that automates root cause identification and reduces reliance on manual triage
5. Improve manufacturing throughput and yield through test optimization

Systems Development & Automation

1. Define and develop software, automation, and enabling tools for server hardware programs; track and report progress
2. Design and build scalable system-level software with focus on durability, availability, security, and diagnostics
3. Develop and maintain device drivers for Linux on ARM and x86 architectures
4. Build automation solutions using modern programming languages (Python, Ruby, Java, C/C++, etc.)
5. Work with OS internals and accelerator/GPU software stacks in Linux-based environments
6. Build, manage, and deploy CI/CD pipelines for rapid deployment of code changes to org-owned and customer-owned systems

Cross-Team Collaboration

1. Work across internal HWEng teams to ensure new server hardware addresses data path and control path functionality needed by dependent service teams
2. Work closely with internal customers to identify early any potential problems onboarding new accelerated compute servers into their ecosystem
3. Engage with ODMs and design partners on testability, diagnostic, and automation requirements during hardware design and development (NPI)
4. Contribute to server design to improve robustness, testability, diagnosability, and reliability
5. Partner with datacenter operations teams to close the loop between field failures and design improvements

A day in the life
You will collaborate with a variety of roles (SDEs, SDETs, Mechanical/Electrical/Hardware Engineers, TPMs, Managers, Principals) and organizations through server conception, test validation, qualification, launch, and operations — driving high quality and reliability into current and future designs for AWS accelerated server solutions. From orchestration tooling development to hardware integration to kernel driver debugging, you dive deep into problems across the breadth of AWS.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering AI/ML development team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching and maintaining server hardware in the fleet — including AI/ML accelerator servers with GPUs. Located in Seattle, Cupertino, and Austin, we work with internal development teams, ODMs, and design partners to deliver servers deployed in datacenters worldwide.

title: Information Security Specialist
description:
Great Falls Public Schools is seeking an integral member of our Data Center Team. This highly skilled technical leader will inherit, manage, and evolve our highly customized enterprise IT and security infrastructure. This hybrid role goes far beyond traditional security administration-it depends on a unique blend of proactive cybersecurity operations, ground-up network architecture, low-level systems programming, and full-stack C# development.

You will be managing everything from active threat hunting and daily security monitoring to custom-built authentication systems and enterprise firewalls.

Essential Functions:

• Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response: Actively monitor, analyze, and correlate telemetry from Azure/Entra logs, FortiGate firewall traffic, Google Workspace logs, Custom IdP logs, Carbon Black logs and Windows Server event logs etc. to detect anomalies. Lead full-lifecycle incident response, behavioral threat hunting, and deep-dive digital forensics using VMware Carbon Black EDR.

• Vulnerability Management & Governance: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning and penetration testing across all network assets and custom-developed applications. Oversee critical, large-scale patch deployments for 5,000+ endpoints. Develop, enforce, and audit IT security policies to ensure strict compliance with educational data privacy laws and cybersecurity insurance mandates.

• Email Security & Phishing Defense: Manage district-wide email security, maintaining and utilizing custom-built web applications dedicated to DMARC, SPF, DKIM, and MTA-STS analysis to prevent spoofing. Design

and execute regular phishing simulation campaigns and security awareness training for district staff.

• Full-Stack Development & Application Maintenance: Maintain, debug, and extend a portfolio of 9 fully custom-developed district applications (including our security tools and IdP) built on C# / ASP.NET Core MVC. Engineer complex PowerShell automation scripts to streamline district-wide system administration and data orchestration.

• Next-Gen Identity Management (IAM): Oversee our custom-built Central Sign-On Identity Provider (IdP). Manage native code-level integrations for FIDO2/WebAuthn, OIDC, and SAML2, federating identities seamlessly across Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace, and PowerSchool SIS(OracleDB).

• Network Architecture & AI Integration: Configure and manage Fortinet FortiGate enterprise firewalls completely from scratch. Maintain and optimize a proprietary Public DNS Server (with AI/ML anomaly detection) and a custom RADIUS server for WiFi authentication.

• Infrastructure & Database Security: Architect a highly available 3-node Hyper-V cluster. Write and optimize secure injection-proof T-SQL and Oracle PL/SQL queries to maintain encrypted data pipelines across Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle databases.

• Unix/Linux Administration: Administer: secure and maintain a critical fleet of 10-20 Unix/Linux servers. Provide dedicated support and security hardening for these systems that cannot be decommissioned, ensuring seamless operation and preventing operational knowledge gaps.

Qualifications:

• Cybersecurity Operations: Hands-on experience with log analysis (Azure, Firewall, Carbon Black, Server logs, etc.), formal incident response methodologies, vulnerability management, email security standards (DMARC), and enterprise EDR platforms (VMware Carbon Black).

• Software Engineering & Automation: Demonstrable proficiency in Advanced C# / ASP.NET Core MVC, front end development (HTML/JS/CSS), and advanced PowerShell scripting.

• Low-Level Systems Programming: Experience with raw socket programming (TCP/UDP), byte-level data manipulation, and binary packet parsing.

• Protocol & Network Mastery: Absolute, code-level understanding of the DNS protocol, RADIUS, and modern IAM protocols (FIDO2, OIDC, SAML2). Proven track record of designing enterprise firewalls (FortiGate) from scratch.

• Database & Systems: Strong background in Hyper-V virtualization and writing secure optimized queries for both SQL Server and Oracle environments.

Additional Experience:

• Practical experience integrating AI / Machine Learning models into backend systems for Risk-Based Authentication (RBA) or predictive threat detection.

• Experience managing IT security, data privacy, and identity life cycles within a K-12 educational environment.

• Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Fortinet NSE, CEH).

LOCATION: District Offices

SALARY: $68,140.00 Starting Wage

title: Systems Administrator
description:
Purpose:

The System Administrator evaluates, implements, and maintains the GISD enterprise, through domain and system administration, email management, network security and services, and server monitoring and security protection.

Nature & Scope:

The Systems Administrator works under supervision of the Technology Director. The nature of the work requires adherence to standard procedures, as well as policies and regulations. Independent judgment and decision making is required in matters not having established procedures. As a member of the Technology Department, the System Administrator engages with highly sensitive information and must maintain absolute integrity of systems and confidentiality of classified data.

Qualifications:

Education/Certification:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or management information systems, or equivalent experience in technical support, hardware and software management.

CompTIA A+ certification preferred but not required

Experience:

Two years' experience with enterprise level daily system administration of operating systems in test and production settings, including server configuration, file systems, devices and device drivers, data communications, monitoring, security, and basic networking (preferred)

2 years of experience performing network maintenance

Advanced experience with Active Directory in an enterprise environment.

Experience with scripting languages used in the administration of enterprise applications.

Experience with enterprise application management.

Experience with troubleshooting complex technical issues and conducting effective research to resolve problems.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing. Must read, understand, and follow multi-step written and verbal instructions in English.

Special Knowledge/Skills:

Knowledge of LAN and WAN network design and installation

Knowledge of network hardware and software applications including network servers, printers, and other equipment

Knowledge of networking protocols and distributed computing environment concepts,

including Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), User Datagram Protocol (UDP) and Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP).

Ability to work with multiple operating systems and network protocols

Ability to analyze and resolve computer network problems

Ability to repair, troubleshoot, diagnose hardware

Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

Major Responsibilities and Duties:

Serves as overall administrator of the District's core information systems and services. Plans, tests,

implements, secures, and provides troubleshooting support.

Develops the necessary tools, processes, and documentation needed to maintain movement towards current strategic goals of the District. Research new developments in the field as necessary in order to improve tools and processes.

Installs, manages, monitors, and integrates various server and client operating systems. Performs scripting and programming tasks.

Administers a variety of database systems.

Provides systems monitoring to track technology and data across the district.

Provides performance tuning to ensure high levels of data and system availability.

Designs, implements, and provides tier-three support for enterprise desktop services and clients.

Administers data backup, disaster recovery, security, and data compliance strategies.

Writes technical instructions and documentation.

Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS)

Core Responsibilities:

As a Vital Record Assistant, you will play a key role by performing various planning, data collection and analysis, administrative and clerical tasks related to the registration and administration of Maine’s vital events. Data, Research, and Vital Statistics (DRVS), within the Department of Health and Human Services. We are seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated front office worker to join our team. Your primary responsibilities will be to oversee the genealogist database, tracking their enrollments and processing their weekly requests for records. You will record and track operational totals monthly. You will review the provider reports of death with dignity patients to ensure compliance with the law and follow up with the physicians on missing or incomplete forms. You should be comfortable undertaking a variety of activities in the office, including filing, answering and routing incoming calls, sorting and delivering mail, organizing and reviewing documents, basic computation, and more. You will be expected to cross train across all areas of vital records. Reliability and a strong work ethic combined with great communication skills are a must.

You will also:

• Maintain the genealogist database, reviewing their applications to determine their eligibility and fulfilling their requests for records.

• Review physician reports for death with dignity legal requirements and follow up with the physicians on any incomplete or missing data.

• Compile monthly counts for vital records services and enter vital records operations totals.

• Prepare reports, charts or graphs on revenue generated from the State Share of Vital Record reports.

• Serve as the primary back up to the front desk operations by greeting and welcoming clients and directing them appropriately.

• Promote a positive, professional image of the office.

• Answer the main phone line, take messages, and redirect calls to appropriate people.

• Copy and/or scan various vital records and/or documents.

• Sort and distribute incoming mail as well as prepare outgoing mail (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Update accounting spreadsheets; record all checks, credit cards and cash received for services.

• Support administrative and special projects requirements, and other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

A two (2) year combination of education, training, and/or experience providing a knowledge of statistics, methods of research and planning, and/or economic analysis.

Preferred candidates will also have:

• Excellent phone and customer service skills with diverse constituents.

• Proven job diligence, dedication and attention to detail.

• Ability to work in a multi-tasked environment with attention to detail, follow through, and flexibility.

• Ability to read and interpret Maine Statutes, rules and regulations related to vital records.

title: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Analyst
description:
Town of Vernon Department: Data Processing

Job Title: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Analyst Bargaining Unit: Professional

Salary: Exempt position - $82,341.23 - $96,946.90 Starting rate commensurate with qualifications and experience

Insurance: Health Savings Account/High Deductible Health Plan $2,000/$4,000 deductible

Pension: Defined Contribution Plan

General Statement of Duties: Responsible for the development, maintenance, analysis, and support of the Town's Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and spatial data assets. This role supports municipal operations by producing mapping solutions, spatial analysis, and data-driven insights for multiple departments. The GIS Analyst ensures data accuracy, system integration, and accessibility of geospatial information to support decision-making, planning, and service delivery.

Supervision Received: Receives general instruction from the Director of Information and Communication Technology or designee.

Supervision Exercised: None

Essential Job Functions: Responsible for managing and maintaining the Town's GIS platform, including spatial databases, web maps, and geospatial applications. The role involves collecting, analyzing, and interpreting geographic data to support municipal operations, infrastructure planning, asset management, and emergency response. Collaborates with multiple Town departments to understand business needs and translate them into GIS solutions, including map creation, dashboards, and data visualizations. Develops and maintains layers such as parcels, utilities, zoning, transportation networks, public safety data etc. Additional responsibilities include supporting system integrations between GIS and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, asset management, permitting systems), performing spatial analysis, and ensuring data integrity and standardization. The role also involves publishing GIS services, maintaining web-based mapping applications, and supporting mobile GIS solutions for field operations. Provides technical support and training to end users, documents workflows and data standards, and coordinates with vendors and regional/state agencies for data sharing and compliance. Supports disaster response and planning efforts through GIS-based mapping and situational awareness tools.

Other Job Functions: May be called in to work at the Town's Emergency Operation Center (EOC). Performs related work as required; other duties as required.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

Hand-eye coordination required operating computer and other office equipment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to concentrate on fine detail with interruption and remember multiple assignments given over long periods of time.

The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required: Knowledge of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) principles, spatial data management, and geospatial analysis; knowledge of GIS software platforms such as Esri ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Enterprise) or similar technologies; knowledge of spatial databases, data models, and query languages (e.g., SQL); familiarity with GPS data collection, coordinate systems, projections, and geospatial data standards; understanding of system integrations between GIS and enterprise systems such as asset management, permitting, ERP, and public safety systems; understanding of data governance, data quality, and information security principles. Ability to create, edit, and maintain spatial datasets including parcels, utilities, infrastructure, zoning, and environmental data; ability to develop maps, dashboards, web applications, and visualizations to support municipal operations and decision-making; ability to perform spatial analysis and interpret geographic data; ability to publish and manage GIS services and web-based mapping applications. Strong technical problem-solving skills with logical and analytical thinking; ability to troubleshoot and resolve GIS-related issues, including data inconsistencies and application errors; ability to support and train end users on GIS tools and applications; ability to document data standards, workflows, and procedures; ability to assist in disaster response and recovery efforts through GIS mapping and data support. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment; adaptability to evolving technologies and municipal needs; ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively; strong communication skills, both oral and written; ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with Town departments, regional agencies, and external partners. Must have and maintain a valid driver's license.

EXPERIENCE AND TRAINING: Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Geospatial Science, Computer Science, Urban Planning, or a related field, with two (2) years of experience in GIS analysis, spatial data management, or a related field; or an Associate's degree in GIS, Geography, or a related field with five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in GIS operations, including spatial data development, mapping, analysis, and system support. Experience working with GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, or Enterprise), spatial databases, and geospatial data standards is required. Experience supporting municipal functions such as public works, planning, utilities, or public safety is highly desirable. Familiarity with GPS data collection, scripting (e.g., Python), and integration of GIS with enterprise systems is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. Proven experience in GIS analysis, cartography, spatial data management, or a similar role is also acceptable.

This job description is not intended to be a complete statement of all duties, functions and responsibilities which comprise this position. EOE/AA

Job Title: Computer Technician II
