title: Assistant Director of Infrastructure and Network Management
description:
Job Description

The Assistant Director of Infrastructure and Network Management serves a critical leadership role in ensuring the security, reliability, and strategic advancement of the school division’s network infrastructure. Reporting to the Director of Infrastructure and Support, this position is responsible for assisting with the design, implementation, cybersecurity oversight, and ongoing management of complex enterprise network systems that support instructional, operational, and administrative functions across the division.

This role will also provide leadership and operational support of the division’s use and management of the new municipal fiber network within the City of Alexandria, ensuring secure, resilient, and high-performing connectivity between schools and division facilities. The position requires deep technical expertise in network infrastructure and cybersecurity, as well as the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage critical infrastructure projects, and guide network staff in achieving strategic technology and security objectives.

This position operates reports to Central Office, and will regularly be in schools in ACPS. This position may require occasional work outside of regular business hours to respond to critical infrastructure or cybersecurity incidents, support network operations, or participate in planned maintenance activities. Travel may be required to attend meetings or training sessions.

Qualifications

Education

A minimum of a Bachelor's degree or commensurate industry experience with focus in information technology strongly preferred. Industry certifications are preferred.

Experience

  • This position requires a minimum of 5- 7 years of experience in the field of network design and management, Management of technical staff, and cybersecurity.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in network design, administration and management, with a proven track record of progressively increasing responsibility.

Key Competencies

  • In-depth knowledge of networking technologies and protocols, including but not limited to Multi-gigabit Ethernet, Routing, TCP/IP, DNS management, DHCP management, VLANs, VPNs, Server Virtualization, SAN, WAN topologies and technologies, WiFi standards and management.
  • Strong communication and management skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical professionals.

Essential Functions

  • Lead and support cybersecurity initiatives for the division’s network infrastructure, including implementing security best practices, monitoring network vulnerabilities, coordinating incident response efforts, and ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity standards and policies.
  • Manage and support the division’s connectivity and operations related to the City of Alexandria’s municipal fiber network, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable network services across schools and administrative facilities.
  • Collaborate with City of Alexandria technology, infrastructure, and public works teams to coordinate municipal network projects, troubleshoot connectivity issues, support cross-agency initiatives, and align network infrastructure planning with division and city strategic goals.
  • Network Infrastructure Management: Oversee the day-to-day aspects of deployment, and maintenance of the organization's network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, VPN, and cloud-based networks.
  • Security Management: Manage network security protocols, including firewall rules and updates, intrusion detection system, the division’s SIEM Alert system.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of network technicians, providing guidance, support, and technical expertise to ensure the smooth operation of the network infrastructure.
  • Strategic Planning: Collaborate with the Director of infrastructure and Support to develop long-term network strategies aligned with organizational goals and objectives. Provide input and recommendations on technology investments and resource allocation.
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Assist in the maintenance of disaster recovery and business continuity plans for the network infrastructure, ensuring that critical systems and data are protected and can be restored in the event of a disruption.

Clearances

  • Criminal Justice fingerprint/Background Clearance
  • Tuberculosis skin test

title: Assemblagemedewerker
description:
Bouw mee aan batterijsystemen van morgen.

Bij Cordeel houden we van mensen die graag maken, verbeteren en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Voor onze activiteiten rond batterijtechnologie zoeken we een ervaren assemblagemedewerker die verder kijkt dan alleen de montage. Iemand die technisch sterk is, kwaliteit vanzelfsprekend vindt en niet stopt bij de vaststelling dat iets niet werkt.

Je bouwt mee aan hoogwaardige batterijsystemen voor professionele toepassingen. Je assembleert, test, analyseert en herstelt. En zie je dat iets slimmer, veiliger of efficiënter kan? Dan verwachten we dat je dat ook zegt.
Kortom: geen klassieke assemblagejob, maar een technische rol met verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt mee aan het volledige assemblageproces van cell-to-module tot module-to-pack. Daarbij combineer je nauwkeurig montagewerk met testen, troubleshooting en kwaliteitscontrole.

Concreet:

  • Assembleren – Je monteert en bouwt klantspecifieke batterijmodules en complete batterypacks voor B2B-toepassingen.
  • Testen – Je voert functionele en elektrische testen uit en controleert of modules en batterijsystemen correct en veilig functioneren.
  • Troubleshooten – Een foutcode of storing? Jij gaat op zoek naar de oorzaak, analyseert het probleem en zorgt voor een passende oplossing.
  • Herstellen – Je herstelt systemen en vervangt waar nodig componenten of cellen.
  • Kwaliteit bewaken – Je voert kritische kwaliteits- en veiligheidscontroles uit op cellen, modules en complete packs.
  • Verbeteren – Je ziet waar het productieproces beter kan en vertaalt dat naar concrete voorstellen.
  • Kennis delen – Dankzij jouw ervaring ben je een technisch aanspreekpunt op de werkvloer en help je nieuwe collega's op weg.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken vooral iemand met technisch inzicht, drive en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
Je hebt minimaal een diploma secundair onderwijs in een technische richting, bijvoorbeeld Elektromechanica, Mechatronica of Elektriciteit.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf hierin:

  • Je hebt ervaring in een assemblage- of productieomgeving.
  • Elektriciteit en/of elektronica zijn je niet vreemd.
  • Ervaring met batterijtechnologie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen absolute must.
  • Je kunt technische tekeningen en elektrische schema's lezen en interpreteren.
  • Je denkt analytisch en zoekt graag uit waarom iets niet werkt.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit en elektrische veiligheid.
  • Je wacht niet af, maar neemt initiatief wanneer je kansen voor verbetering ziet.
  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken én communiceert vlot met collega's.
  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands. Praktische kennis van het Engels is een plus.


Wat krijg je van ons?

Je komt terecht in een technische omgeving waar innovatie geen modewoord is, maar iets waar je iedere dag aan meebouwt.

We bieden je:

  • Een voltijdse functie in dagregime, met ruimte voor een gezonde werk-privébalans.
  • Een vlot bereikbare werkplek in de regio Oudenaarde.
  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris in functie van je ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden.
  • Een brede waaier aan extralegale voordelen.
  • De kans om je technische kennis verder uit te bouwen binnen batterijtechnologie en energieopslag.
  • Ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verbeteringen voor te stellen en mee te groeien met een toekomstgerichte activiteit.


Klaar om mee te bouwen?

Wil jij niet gewoon onderdelen assembleren, maar begrijpen wat je bouwt, hoe het werkt en hoe het beter kan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Join the family of builders.

title: Talent Development and Engagement Specialist
description:
Get Set for Cumberlands!


Join our team of student-focused individuals working together in order to encourage intellectual and spiritual growth, leadership and service.

CURRENT STUDENT or EMPLOYEE? Please log into Workday and use the Career Tile to find and apply to jobs from our internal career sites.

The Talent Development and Engagement Specialist supports and coordinates the University’s efforts to attract, welcome, develop, and retain employees. The position manages staff recruitment, coordinates employee and supervisor development, administers the performance evaluation program, and develops employee recognition, engagement, and career development initiatives. The Specialist works closely with supervisors and University leadership to strengthen the employee experience and build practical programs that reflect the University’s core values of Serve, Elevate, and Innovate. This includes providing responsive and service-minded support, helping employees and supervisors contribute to an exceptional student experience, and continually looking for better ways to recruit, develop, recognize, and retain employees.

Essential Responsibilities

Onboarding Program Development and Employee Experience

  • Help design, evaluate, and improve the University-wide onboarding program for new staff employees in partnership with the HR Generalist and Executive Vice President for Human Resources.
  • Develop and maintain onboarding resources, supervisor checklists, and 30/60/90-day tools that help new employees understand the University, their role, workplace expectations, and how core values should be reflected in their work.
  • Partner with the HR colleagues to evaluate the onboarding experience and recommend improvements.
  • Develop practical follow-up tools and feedback methods for new employees and supervisors during the first several months of employment, and use the results to improve the onboarding program.

Learning and Development

  • Develop and maintain an annual employee and supervisor training plan based on institutional needs and feedback from leaders and employees, with particular attention to service, the employee and student experience, leadership effectiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Create and coordinate supervisor development programs covering topics such as hiring, onboarding, communication, coaching, documentation, performance management, employee recognition, conflict resolution and difficult conversations.
  • Coordinate leadership and professional development opportunities for employees at different career stages.
  • Identify appropriate internal and external training resources and facilitate programs as needed.
  • Maintain training materials and participation records and evaluate whether programs are meeting their intended purpose.
  • Partner with subject matter experts to coordinate required employment-related training.

Performance Management

  • Administer the annual performance evaluation process, including the calendar, communications, forms or system workflow, and completion tracking.
  • Train supervisors and employees on goal setting, constructive feedback, effective evaluations, and development planning, including meaningful ways to connect performance expectations to core values and strategic initiatives.
  • Review the performance management process regularly and recommend improvements that make evaluations more useful and consistent.
  • Partner with the HR Generalist on situations involving significant performance concerns, corrective action, or performance improvement plans.

Employee Engagement and Recognition

  • Develop and coordinate employee recognition and appreciation programs, including service recognition and meaningful recognition of employees who demonstrate Serve, Elevate, and Innovate in their work.
  • Coordinate employee engagement surveys, pulse surveys, stay interviews, or other listening efforts as appropriate.
  • Analyze feedback and workforce trends and work with leaders to identify practical actions that improve engagement and retention.

Career Development and Internal Growth

  • Help develop career paths, job families, and career development resources that provide employees a clearer understanding of opportunities for growth and encourage continued learning, adaptability, and innovation.
  • Promote internal mobility and help supervisors identify development opportunities for employees.
  • Support individual development planning, mentoring, cross-training, and other career development efforts.
  • Assist HR leadership with succession planning and development strategies for critical positions and future leaders.

Recruitment and Hiring

  • Coordinate full-cycle recruitment for staff positions, from posting through accepted offer.
  • Partner with hiring managers to review position needs, develop job postings, identify recruiting sources, and establish an effective search process that reflects the University’s commitment to service and a positive candidate experience.
  • Maintain the applicant tracking process and provide timely, professional communication to candidates and hiring managers.
  • Help hiring managers develop interview questions, selection criteria, and consistent interviewing practices.
  • Support candidate sourcing and outreach for difficult-to-fill positions and identify opportunities to strengthen the University’s employer presence.
  • Coordinate reference checks, background checks, offer documentation, and other pre-employment steps in partnership with other HR staff.
  • Maintain recruiting records and monitor useful measures such as vacancies, time to fill, applicant sources, and offer acceptance.

Program Administration and Collaboration

  • Maintain accurate records and documentation for assigned talent programs.
  • Use HR data and employee feedback to evaluate recruiting, onboarding, development, performance, engagement, and retention efforts.
  • Prepare reports and recommendations for HR leadership and other University leaders as requested.
  • Work closely with the HR Generalist, Benefits and Payroll, Leave and HRIS, and Payroll staff to provide a coordinated employee experience.
  • Stay current on effective talent management and higher education employment practices and recommend reasonable improvements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Education, or a related field.
  • At least three years of progressively responsible experience in human resources, talent management, recruiting, learning and development, employee engagement, or a related area.
  • Experience coordinating multiple HR programs or projects from planning through implementation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with employees and supervisors at all levels.
  • Good judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience working in a college or university environment.
  • Experience developing supervisor or leadership training programs.
  • Experience with applicant tracking, performance management, learning, or HRIS systems.

Key Competencies

  • Serve: service-oriented, responsive, collaborative, and willing to support others with care and professionalism
  • Elevate: committed to strengthening the employee experience in ways that help employees and supervisors better serve students and advance the University’s mission
  • Innovate: curious, adaptable, and willing to improve processes, test practical ideas, and find better ways to support employees and the University
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Sound judgment and discretion
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to work across departments
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset

Working Relationships

The Specialist works regularly with supervisors, department leaders, faculty and staff, and other members of Human Resources. The position also works with outside recruiting, training, and professional development partners as needed.

Cumberlands is different by design. Our employees exemplify our motto in the pursuit of a

“life-more-abundant.”

3. Team Leadership & Communication

5. project tracking

6. Risk & Issue Management

Identify potential risks, formulate prevention and response plans. Resolve project issues and obstacles promptly to ensure smooth execution.

7. Stakeholder Management

Communicate project status regularly, manage expectations, and collect feedback. Maintain good relationships with clients and related parties. Resolve conflicts and unexpected issues to ensure achievement of project objectives.

8. Project Documentation & Closure

Complete project records, reports, and documents. Organize project acceptance, summary, and experience review for continuous improvement.

• Budget planning & cost control

• Risk identification, assessment & mitigation

• Scope management & change control

• Quality assurance & deliverable management

• Project documentation & report writing

2. Soft Skills

• Strong leadership & team management

• Excellent communication & negotiation skills

• Problem-solving & decision-making ability

• Time management & prioritization

• Adaptability & pressure resistance

FREDERICKSBURG CITY PUBLIC SCHOOLS JOB DESCRIPTION

TITLE: INSTRUCTIONAL TECHNOLOGY COACH (ITC) – 12 MONTHS

PRIMARY FUNCTION:

Under the supervision of the Technology department, this position provides instructional support and technical assistance to promote innovative and effective learning environments based on research-based best practices in instruction. The Instructional Technology Coach (ITC) assists in the identification of appropriate resources which complement the schools' instructional programs, provides professional learning opportunities, collaborates with instructional staff, and supports division instructional goals. The ITC also supports the work of the Technology department in the implementation, management, and support of instructional technology throughout the division.

The following Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, and Performance Responsibilities are given by way of example, and are not intended to be all inclusive and are not set forth in order of importance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Graduation from an accredited college or university with a minimum of a bachelor's degree, required.
  2. A valid Virginia teacher certificate, required.
  3. Five years of exceptional teaching experience and/or combined ITC experience, required.
  4. Advanced technical proficiency in the use of Windows OS, iOS, Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Office 365, Web Publishing software and various instructional software programs.
  5. Experience in coaching, professional development, and/or school leadership, preferred.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Technology Support:

  • Troubleshoot variety of technologies including, but not limited to laptops, iPads, projectors, instructional programs and software, and other student and teacher devices.
  • Support implementation and management of instructional technology devices and programs.

Change Agent:

  • Create a shared vision and culture for using technology to learn. Facilitate equitable use of digital learning tools and content.
  • Cultivate a supportive coaching culture.

Connected Learner:

  • Model professional learning that deepens personal expertise for educators and leaders.
  • Actively participate in professional learning networks to enhance coaching practice and keep current with emerging technology and innovations in pedagogy and the learning sciences.
  • Establish shared goals with educators, reflect on successes and continually improve coaching and teaching practice.

Collaborator:

  • Collaborate with instructional leaders to determine appropriate use of instructional technology.
  • Establish trusting and respectful coaching relationships.
  • Partner with educators to identify digital learning content that is culturally relevant, developmentally appropriate and aligned to content standards.
  • Partner with educational leaders to evaluate the efficacy of digital learning content and tools.
  • Plan and model the effective use of technology to improve student learning.

Learning Designer:

  • Collaborate with educators to develop authentic, active learning experiences that foster student agency, deepen content mastery and allow students to demonstrate their competency.
  • Help educators use digital tools to create effective assessments.
  • Collaborate with educators to design accessible and active digital learning environments.

Professional Learning Facilitator:

  • Design professional learning based on needs assessments and frameworks for working with adults to support learning needs.
  • Build capacity of educators, leaders, and instructional teams to put the ISTE Standards into practice by facilitating active learning and providing meaningful feedback.
  • Evaluate impact of professional learning and continually make improvements.

Data-Driven Decision-Maker:

  • Assist educators and leaders in securely collecting and analyzing student data.
  • Support educators to interpret qualitative and quantitative data to inform their decisions and support individual student learning.
  • Partner with educators to empower students to use learning data to set their own goals and measure their progress.
  • Model and support the use of qualitative and quantitative data to guide instruction and professional learning.

Digital Citizen Advocate:

  • Partner with educators, leaders, students, and families to foster a culture of respectful online interactions and a healthy balance in their use of technology.
  • Support educators and students to critically examine the sources of online media and identify underlying assumptions.
  • Empower educators, leaders, and students to make informed decisions to protect their personal data and curate the digital profile they intend to reflect.
  • Perform other duties as required.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT: 12 months

EVALUATION:

Performance in this job will be evaluated in accordance with school board policy and administrative regulations of teachers.

title: Liker du mat og folk? Sitter smilet og latteren løst? MENY Ski Storsenter sin ferskvareavdeling ser etter en som deg!
description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.

Stillingsomfang: 100%
Arbeidstid: dag, kveld og annenhver helg
Oppstartsdato: 01.10.2026 - eller etter avtale.

Søknadsfrist: Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

For å søke må du være fylt 18 år og du må kunne beherske norsk.

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Du vil også arbeide i bakeriavdelingen der oppgavene består i å steke brød, rydde, legge opp varer til neste dag og hjelpe kunder. For å trives med dette må du like å ha kontakt med mennesker, ha gode samarbeidsevner og ikke være redd for å brette opp ermene for å ta i et tak.

Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss! For å lykkes må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.

Hvordan er det å jobbe på MENY Ski Storsenter?

Alle som begynner i MENY vil lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Vi har en interaktiv kursplattform, ulike klasseromskurs som gir deg faglig påfyll og et traineeprogram med fokus på å gå fra ansatt til å bli leder, for å nevne noe. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!

Her på MENY Ski Storsenter vil du jobbe i en av de største og fineste butikkene i landet. Vi har derfor noen flere ansatte enn i mange andre butikker og et høyt fagnivå. Her er det med andre ord mange å lære av. Vi satser og liker å drive god butikk. Om vi skal låne en idrettsmetafor så kan du si at vi liker å «blø for drakta».

Vi er opptatt av å trives på jobb og liker å spre glede og latter. Vi tar vare på hverandre og er opptatt av at alle skal bli sett. Å drive en stor butikk er avhengig av godt samarbeid mellom alle. Velkommen skal du være!

Å søke jobb i MENY skal være enkelt

Du trenger ikke laste opp søknadsbrev. For at vi skal bli litt bedre kjent med deg, svarer du på spørsmålene om deg og din erfaring. Har du mye på hjertet må du gjerne skrive utfyllende, vi gleder oss til å lese! Og fordi vi synes det er spennende å se hvor du har vært tidligere, må du laste opp CV.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at alle søknader må sendes inn via søknadsskjema tilknyttet annonsen, dette er av hensyn til ditt personvern, samt at vi ønsker å være sikre på at vi klarer å følge opp alle kandidater på en god måte. Vi kan derfor ikke ta imot søknader på papir i butikken eller via e-post. Søknader behandles fortløpende.

Kontaktperson

MENY er Norges største supermarkedkjede med nesten 200 butikker og en omsetning på over 20 milliarder kroner. Vi har 10 000 stolte matarbeidere som sørger for gode handleopplevelser hver eneste dag!

title: Developer - Application Integration
description:
SUMMARY Provide service and support for enterprise-wide application integration and data messaging environments. Responsibilities include analysis of functional requirements, design, implementation and maintenance of District integration systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Under general supervision, design and construct application integration mechanisms that allow district systems to communicate with each other efficiently, reliably, and cost effectively while adhering to high-quality development principles. This should include error handling with appropriate levels of logging.

Create application process flow diagrams and other design documentation, including clear comments within code where applicable.

Collaborate with other software developers, business analysts and project managers to estimate, plan, design, develop, test, and maintain products and components.

Participate in peer-reviews of code and designs.

Adhere to established change management processes and procedures.

Monitor logs and error reports as required based on industry standards.

Anticipate and resolve emergency situations which occur in District application integrations during normal District business hours; provide after-hours support on request.

Report/monitor support incidents on vendor support sites; communicate feedback on open support cases.

Provide knowledge transfer with peers and customers on system technical functionality, purpose, decision modeling, and troubleshooting, using a variety of methods and tools (e.g. Excel, Access), including data modeling, scenario projections, documentation, training materials, flowcharts.

Advise, collaborate, and communicate with all levels of district employees, both school-based and central.

Represent District while working collaboratively with vendors, contracts, businesses, and governmental agencies.

Assist with evaluating and examining new software and hardware under general supervision.

Perform other duties as assigned.

SENIOR LEVEL DUTIES

Requires limited supervision generally; plan and drive projects; guide technical direction of projects.

Evaluate, devise, examine and recommend, for management approval, new software and hardware using knowledge of existing data and systems.

Provide technical expertise to teammates through coaching and mentorship.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EXPERIENCE
1-5 years experience in software development. Senior level experience: 5+ years experience in software development and application integration. Technical skills/experience in C# .NET, ASP.NET; SQL Server: database objects, queries, programming and tuning; Visual Studio; Team Foundation Server or equivalent source control system. Preferred technical skills/experience in XML, JSON, Web Services, WebAPI; MVC; JavaScript / AJAX, Client Side frameworks/libraries (jQuery), HTML5/CSS3, LINQ; Oracle: PL/SQL; Agile; Entity framework, dependency injection, familiarity with SOLID.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING Bachelor's degree in Information systems, computer science, business/management or related field or equivalent experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS Oracle certification and/or MSEC (Microsoft Engineer Certification) preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, & EQUIPMENT Oral and written presentation and communication, interpersonal, system thinking, conflict resolution, analytical, and organizational skills. Proficiency in legacy and state-of-the-art computer systems consistent with District-wide Technology Plan. Ability to stay current with changes in technology. Programming ability with proficiency in multiple computer languages, system design, and analytical skills. Knowledge of and experience with, productivity/desktop tools, operating systems, multi-platform computer hardware and related complex software.

DECISION MAKING Requires the timely application of technical knowledge and knowledge of District procedures and processes. Requires detailed analysis for possible conflicts or adverse impacts to production system data flow and accuracy. Must coordinate with system(s) production calendars to schedule installations without impacting the district users. An incorrect decision could cause the district-wide systems to be unavailable for users, perform poorly, or cause a loss of data from the system due to incorrect configurations or installation. If there was a system failure or loss of data, this could cause an embarrassment to the district by impacting staff, students, parents, and various state and federal reporting agencies. This could ultimately cause a loss or delay of revenues and negatively impact the district?s reputation. Errors could potentially result in substantial embarrassment and/or cost to the district.

COMMUNITY RELATIONS Daily contact with professional staff within department to discuss routine internal matters, obtain/furnish information, resolve routine corrections/adjustments, maintain relationships; with professional staff outside department and vendors, contractors, engineers, and developers to discuss routine internal matters, obtain/furnish information, resolve routine corrections/adjustments, and maintain relationships; with classified staff within department to discuss routine internal matters and obtain/furnish information; Occasional contact with public agencies such as Colorado Department of Education to obtain/furnish information, resolve routine corrections/adjustments, and maintain relationships. Annual contact with advisory committees and school support team to discuss routine internal matters, obtain/furnish information, resolve routine corrections/adjustments, and maintain relationships; and with classified staff outside department to discuss routine internal matters and obtain/furnish information.

SPAN OF CONTROL This job has no supervisory responsibilities; however, this position assists in the interview process and screening of applicants.

EDUCATIONAL DELIVERY Provide support services for educational technology, educational resources, staff development training, transportation, Diverse Learners, Health Services, Human Resources, and other business applications. Provide support to schools and students with various district-wide financial and student systems used on a daily basis. These systems process and store financial transactions from receipt of cash of fees from parents, purchase transactions, student attendance, student grades and assessment information for students. These systems are used by classified, administrators, and teachers at all sites throughout the District. The majority of time is not spent on the school site.

COMPLEXITY OF WORK The work is primarily directed by the Manager, Development, Enterprise Application Architecture to meet the needs of the requests based on implementation plans, system upgrades or the Application Issue system. Requires independent judgment and thinking, interpretation of facts, technical and analytical skills, application of technical knowledge and analysis of the impact a situation/decision has on the District. Must be able analyze, synthesize, gather information, calculate, and interpret information. Must have strong ability to solve system problems.

The physical demands, mental functions, and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

PHYSICAL DEMANDS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee is frequently required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. There are no specific vision requirements for this position.

MENTAL FUNCTIONS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to compare, analyze, coordinate, compute, synthesize, evaluate, negotiate, instruct, copy and compile. The employee is frequently required to use interpersonal skills.

WORK ENVIRONMENT The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

description:

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Major Duties :• Responsible for day to day client servicing. Including account opening, account servicing and maintenance as well as trade execution. Onboards new client relationships through correspondence, reports, new account paperwork, and advisory agreements. • Supports Financial Advisor(s) in the process of evaluating investment objectives to provide guidance to clients as appropriate given risk tolerance, income needs, and current market environment. • Builds relationships with Financial Advisors, internal and external business partners, and clients by delivering exceptional proactive service. • Works with internal partners (Sales, Operations, Management, or other relationship managers) to respond to client needs/requests. • As subject area expert to other associates and advisors, providing comprehensive, in-depth consulting and leadership to team and partners at a high technical level. • Maintain relevant client information in Client Relationship Management system. • Organizes and maintains client records in accordance with firm, industry, and regulatory compliance. • Carries out activities that are large in scope, cross-functional and technically challenging. • Role is balanced between high level operational execution and development, and execution of strategic direction of business function activities. • Responsible for direct interaction with different committees and/or management. • Strategic in developing, implementing and administering programs within functional areas. • Solves problems in straightforward situations. • Analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents. • Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. • Works within guidelines and policies. Knowledge :• Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills are required. • Thorough knowledge of investment products through prior work experience is required (stocks, bonds, mutual funds, options). • Organizational skills and the ability to prioritize are essential. • Technical skills / systems knowledge (e.g. Microsoft Office, Wealthscape, Morningstar Analytics, Thomson ONE are recommended. • Requires expanded conceptual knowledge in own job discipline. • Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. • Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations. Experience :• A College or University degree is preferred. • FINRA Securities Industry Essentials Exam (SIE) , Series 7 or 7TO and 63/65 or 66 are required. • Three or more years working in a client facing service role in the brokerage, investment advisory or financial services environment is preferred. • Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. • Provides informal guidance and training to new team members.

Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Phasor, we're focused on the big picture and the small details.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Quanta Services, we provide engineering and design services across transmission & distribution, substations, protection & control, geomatics, civil & structural design, telecommunications, panel fabrication, and the testing and commissioning of medium and high-voltage electrical infrastructure.

Be part of a team that delivers projects from conceptual engineering and detailed design through construction support, commissioning, and startup. Built on technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to safety and quality, we take on complex challenges together.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Distribution Engineer to join our engineering team.

In this role, you will support the design of overhead and underground power distribution systems, contributing to projects from concept development through detailed engineering, construction support, and project delivery.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and delivering reliable power distribution solutions, this role offers meaningful technical work, diverse project exposure, and opportunities for long-term professional growth.

What You'll Do

  • Design overhead and underground power distribution systems ranging from 4 kV to 500 kV for utility, industrial, and infrastructure projects
  • Prepare engineering scopes, cost estimates, calculations, and detailed design packages in accordance with applicable utility and industry standards
  • Develop distribution line designs using PLS-CADD; experience with QuickPole or SpidaCalc is considered an asset
  • Coordinate with clients, utilities, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams to support project delivery
  • Collect, interpret, and organize engineering and vendor data while developing bills of materials
  • Coordinate with other business units to support project requirements, schedules, and design integration
  • Assist in maintaining engineering standards, procedures, and best practices
  • Support permitting activities and coordinate with regulatory authorities as required
  • Resolve technical challenges while working closely with senior engineers and project teams
  • Contribute to proposals, technical documentation, and engineering deliverables

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 7+ years of experience in electrical distribution engineering, with a strong focus on complex or industrial distribution system design
  • Proficiency with PLS-CADD; experience with QuickPole or SpidaCalc is considered an asset
  • Working knowledge of utility distribution standards, including FortisBC, FortisAlberta, ATCO, Hydro One, or similar utility requirements
  • Experience with overhead distribution design and aerial communications systems using CSA 22.3 No. 1-20 and AEUC standards
  • Understanding of permitting processes for utility infrastructure projects is considered an asset
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering, construction, or telecommunications projects
  • Familiarity with power system operations, installation practices, and utility standards is considered an asset
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office

Why Phasor Engineering

At Phasor Engineering, you'll have the opportunity to be part of some of North America's most complex utility, industrial, and infrastructure projects while collaborating with a highly skilled multidisciplinary team. We offer a supportive and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, professional growth, and teamwork are valued.

As part of Quanta Services, you'll benefit from the resources and stability of an industry leader while maintaining the agility and culture of a growing engineering consultancy.

Whether you're looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or advance your career, you'll find opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Paid time off, wellness programs, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Diverse utility and infrastructure project exposure
  • Opportunities for technical growth and leadership development
  • Collaborative teams built on technical excellence

Phasor Engineering is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We thank everyone for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Accessibility: Phasor Engineering is committed to an inclusive and accessible workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process and employment. If you require accommodation at any stage of the process, please let us know and we will work with you to make appropriate arrangements.

Phasor may use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people.

title: Network Engineer
description:
The Miami Valley Educational Computer Association (MVECA) is seeking a skilled and service-oriented Network Engineer to join our expanding technical team. This position plays a key role in supporting the technology infrastructure of school districts and local government agencies across the region. If you are passionate about networking, virtualization, cybersecurity, problem-solving, and helping organizations succeed through technology, we encourage you to apply.

About MVECA
MVECA is a regional technology service provider delivering high-quality network, cybersecurity, hosting, data, and support services to schools and government organizations. Our team values professionalism, collaboration, and continuous improvement in service to our member communities.

Position Overview
The Network Engineer is responsible for planning, implementing, and maintaining network and security technologies that support MVECA and its client organizations. This role ensures reliable uptime, strong security, and high-quality service delivery across a wide variety of networks and environments.
The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with excellent communication skills, the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users, and a dedication to outstanding customer service.

Key Responsibilities
Provide leadership and technical expertise in delivering network support services to client organizations
Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network switching, routing, LAN/WAN systems, and firewalls
Maintain datacenter equipment, virtual environments, server operating systems
Implement and maintain network security measures and industry best practices
Coordinate installations, upgrades, and repairs with districts, vendors, and telecommunications providers
Monitor bandwidth usage and network performance to identify and resolve issues
Prepare documentation, project plans, reports, and inventories
Order, test, and validate equipment for deployment
Maintain professional certifications (CCNA or CCNP)
Support broader MVECA technology initiatives and collaborate with team members effectively

Qualifications
Education & Certifications
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in computer science, network technology, or a related field
Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification (or the ability to obtain/maintain certification)
Required Skills
Expertise in switching, routing, and network infrastructure
Experience with WAN/LAN technologies and firewall systems
Ability to support PC/Mac networking across various operating systems
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize competing tasks
Clear oral and written communication skills
Ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical users
Strong teamwork and interpersonal communication
Other Requirements
Valid driver’s license
Ability to meet health and background check requirements
Physical & Work Environment Requirements
Frequent travel to client sites
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. regularly and occasionally up to 100 lbs. with assistive equipment
Work may include climbing ladders, crawling under desks, or working in confined spaces
Occasional exposure to seasonal weather during travel
Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Salary commensurate with experience. 260-day employment contract. To apply, please email your resume to employment@mveca.org.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

title: Educational Applications Specialist
description:
Job Description / Essential Elements

Welcome to the home of LEADERS



Mission: Culver educates its students for leadership and responsible citizenship in society by developing and nurturing the whole individual, mind, spirit, and body, through integrated programs that emphasize the cultivation of character.



Culver Academies is a private boarding school. We enroll students from across the United States and around the world. We are seeking diverse talent to support our mission and enrich our learning environment. At Culver, we are always looking to strengthen our organizational leadership by adding outstanding talent to our staff whose passion is to serve our students.



Our location in Culver, Indiana is on the shore of Lake Maxinkuckee, Culver Academies encompasses 1,800 acres of green hills and woodlands, and a historic collegiate-like campus with beautiful Gothic buildings and architecture.



Culver Academies seeks an Educational Applications Specialist to serve as the bridge between our technology systems and our campus community. In this dynamic role, you'll be the behind-the-scenes orchestrator who makes technology work seamlessly for faculty, staff, and students, ensuring new community members have immediate access to the tools they need and supporting transitions between school years.

This person understands how teachers think and work, and uses that understanding to configure systems that support pedagogy, not just administration. In this role, you will manage access and onboarding for faculty, staff, and students; maintain and configure our suite of enterprise applications; and lead transitions between academic years. You will collaborate directly with faculty to ensure that competency-based grading structures and LMS configurations accurately reflect how academic departments define and assess student learning. Success in this role looks like teachers who feel supported and heard, new colleagues who are fully set up and supported from day one, and platforms that work together with seamless data integrations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

User and Access Management

  • Welcome new faculty, staff, and students to our technology ecosystem by setting up their accounts and access across all platforms.
  • Coordinate offboarding procedures while maintaining security protocols for departing community members.

Application Configuration and Maintenance

  • Configure and fine-tune our suite of educational applications including Veracross, Toddle, and Blackbaud.
  • Collaborate with end users to customize systems that match their workflows. Translate faculty pedagogical needs, including competency-based grading workflows, into system configurations.
  • Jump into troubleshooting mode when issues arise, working with vendors and colleagues to find creative solutions.
  • Test new features and updates before rollout, ensuring smooth experiences for our community.
  • Build and maintain helpful documentation so others can learn alongside you.

Annual Academic Operations

  • Lead the transition between school years/camp years in our educational platforms.
  • Orchestrate year-end and start-of-year system configurations, working closely with academic leadership to get everything ready for registration and the start of school/camp.
  • Import class schedules and student rosters, ensuring every student and teacher can hit the ground running.
  • Bring new platform features to life by implementing modules that enhance teaching and learning.

Data Integration Management

  • Keep our systems talking to each other smoothly by building well-maintained integrations using APIs.
  • Investigate and resolve complex data integration issues between systems, implementing fixes and process improvements to maintain system integrity.
  • Team up with vendors and internal colleagues to design and deploy new integrations as we adopt innovative tools.
  • Perform system audits to ensure data is kept up to date.
    Create clear documentation of how our systems connect and share information.

Collaboration and Support

  • Build relationships across campus to understand how different departments use technology.
  • Become the primary technical liaison for faculty and staff, providing advanced system guidance, configuration support, and optimization strategies.
  • Serve as a faculty-facing technology partner to ensure the LMS platform supports, rather than constrains, their teaching practice.
  • Contribute your ideas and energy to process optimization projects that advance institutional technology strategy.
  • Manage and monitor ticket queues within SLA targets, triage incidents by severity, and act as Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation point for complex technical issues.
  • Independently troubleshoot, analyze, solve, and correct issues in real time, providing problem resolution and detailed feedback to the reporting user.
  • Perform additional technical, operational, and project-based responsibilities as required to support IT service continuity and institutional objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical support, educational technology, or application support. A bachelor's degree is preferred.
  • Background in education or direct experience working in K-12 or secondary education environments.
  • Comfortable working with data, including importing, exporting, and understanding how information flows between systems.
  • Excellent English-language reading and writing skills for responding to inquiries and drafting correspondence.
  • Excellent communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.


TOTAL REWARDS: Culver offers much to complement your pay. Our health benefits include medical (Health Savings Account available), dental, and vision insurance options offered at extremely affordable rates and one of our most valued offerings is our FREE on-site Health Clinic including various FREE generic medications. Financial planning benefits include Life Insurance and a 403b retirement account with a very generous company match. At Culver we seek to support your whole self – mind, spirit, and body, which is why you have one hour of paid fitness time per week, 10 paid holidays and paid vacation time is offered after a 60-day orientation period. Culver also offers one FREE meal in the dining hall during the workday and a discount at the Campus Store and Uniform Shop. A strong Tuition Remission Program and scholarship opportunities are available for your eligible children attending both schools and camps.



Culver Academies is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

description:

BASIC FUNCTION: Under the direction of assigned supervisor, the Telecommunications Technician is responsible for telephone hardware and cabling infrastructure support, trouble shooting, daily repair and maintenance of the telephone environment, related communications equipment and intercom/bell/clocks/speaker systems. The Telecommunications Technician is responsible for the maintenance and installation of voice wiring. Will provide timely resolution, provide technical guidance to end-users and support general operations.

REPRESENTATIVE DUTIES: (Incumbents may perform any combination of the essential functions shown below. This position description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, knowledge, or abilities associated with this classification, but is intended to reflect the principal job elements accurately.)

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Install, diagnose, program, and repair a variety of analog, digital telephone, IP switches, intercom/bell/clocks/speaker systems and related equipment at schools and other district sites.
  • Install, terminate, test and troubleshoot voice cable systems.
  • Suggest problem resolution strategies related to cable infrastructure problems.
  • Use a variety of test equipment for repairs and computers for diagnosis and programming needs.
  • Monitor the telecommunications work of outside contractors to ensure that the projects are satisfactory completed and within local, state, federal and District codes, regulations and specifications.
  • Install and relocate telephone and intercom/bell/clocks/speaker systems and equipment as directed by assigned supervisor.
  • Install and repair of voice and intercom/bell/clocks/speaker wiring with full knowledge of Category 5-6 (or standard) copper wire and fiber optic cabling requirements.
  • Operate hand and power tools.
  • Determine needs and order materials for the maintenance or replacement of equipment or systems.
  • Make labor and materials cost estimates.
  • Work from blueprints and schematic diagrams.
  • Confer with contractors regarding the installation and repair of lines and equipment.
  • Maintain records including time, inventory, stock usage, and items repaired or in need of repair.
  • Respond to emergency repair needs.
  • Provide assistance to end-users by demonstrating the operation of telephones, intercom/bell/clocks/speaker and voice mail services.
  • Attend and participate in approved meetings, conferences and seminars to maintain current knowledge of technological advances in the field.
  • Coordinate and work with personnel from other areas to complete assignments.
  • Drive a light truck; transport a variety of tools, equipment and supplies to ensure the availability of materials required at job site.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

TRAINING, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school supplemented by college-level course work or vocational training in telecommunications equipment repair and three years experience in the installation and repair of telephone switches and voice systems. Training in electronics, intercom/bell/clocks/speaker and communication systems may be substituted for experience.

Telephone Company experiences a plus.

LICENSES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Manufacturer’s certification is desirable
  • Valid California Driver’s license with no restrictions which would preclude driving on the job is a continuous requirement
  • Employment eligibility will include fingerprints, tuberculosis and/or other employment clearance

KNOWLEDGE OF:

  • Applicable federal, state, and District codes, safety codes, regulations, policies and procedures governing work scope
  • Telephone company facilities including trunks, ISDN, and T1
  • Telecommunication terminology
  • Analog and digital station equipment
  • Category 5-6 (or current standard) cabling and termination
  • Fiber optic cable requirements and termination
  • All standards of phone/data transmission wiring, repair and termination
  • Proper color coding for wire installation
  • Record-keeping and report preparation techniques
  • Diverse academic, socio-economic, cultural, ethnic, and disability backgrounds of District students
  • Interpersonal skills using, tact, patience and courtesy
  • Reading and writing English communications skills
  • Computer software, hardware, and related technology

ABILITY TO:

  • Install, program, troubleshoot, and repair a variety of telephone switches, and intercom/bell/clocks/speaker and related electronic communications equipment
  • Provide technical training and support to District staff in the use of telecommunications equipment, intercom/bell/clocks/speaker and related systems
  • Expand telephone networks and related systems
  • Operate specialized test equipment and hand and power tools
  • Map strategies to solve problems
  • Read blueprints, plans and specifications
  • Communicate with various customers in the school environment
  • Communicate effectively both orally and in writing
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
  • Understand and follow oral and written instructions
  • Meet schedules and timelines

  • Stay current with the changes in the telecommunications and cabling field
  • Work independently with little direction
  • Operate personal computer, related software, and other office equipment

WORKING CONDITIONS

ENVIRONMENT:

Indoor and outdoor setting; school and central office sites; working around machinery with moving parts; construction areas; exposure to electrical power supply; driving a vehicle to conduct work; fast-paced work; constant interruptions; emergency call-out

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Strength and energy sufficient to maintain a rigorous work schedule involving driving and/or continuous, heavy physical exertion; hearing and speaking to exchange information; seeing to perform assigned duties; sitting or standing for extended periods of time; dexterity of hands and fingers to operate tools and equipment; kneeling, bending at the waist, and reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally, to make repairs; lifting heavy objects.

title: Lagersäljare till K-bygg Jönköping
description:
Är du en ambitiös och positiv lagspelare som vill vara med på vår resa mot branschens mest nöjda kunder. Då är du varmt välkommen till oss på K-Bygg, en del av Kesko Sverige!

På ett lite större plan är vi på K-Bygg just nu inne i ett väldigt spännande skede med företaget och varumärket. Som helägt dotterbolag till internationella handelskoncernen Kesko – med verksamhet i Norden och Baltikum – har vi alla möjligheter att bli nummer ett för proffs inom bygg och renovering och hemmafixare.

K-Bygg erbjuder
Hos K-Bygg, en del av Kesko Sverige, fokuserar vi på människan - oavsett om det handlar om kunder, medarbetare eller partners. Bygg och renovering handlar om förtroende - och med kunskap, rätt sortiment och bra service möter vi kunderna på deras villkor för att ta deras projekt framåt. Vi värdesätter därför det personliga engagemanget hos våra medarbetare extra mycket då vi är övertygade om att det är just det som är nyckeln till goda och hållbara relationer och affärer.

Vi är en trygg arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal, där man blir en del av en snabbväxande och framgångsrik organisation – med varumärkena K-Bygg och Onninen - som kombinerar internationell storlek med lokal förankring.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som Butik- och lagersäljare är dina främsta arbetsuppgifter att ge god service och hjälpa kunden på bästa sätt. Det innebär bland annat att på ett serviceinriktat sätt hjälpa våra kunder med lastning, lossning av gods, plock av kundorder samt påfyllning av varor. Du kommer att ansvara för att guida kunden rätt i anläggningen, ge korrekt information vid frågor, se till att kunden lämnar anläggningen nöjd, samt att arbeta för en fin arbetsmiljö på lagret och anläggningen. Arbete i butiken förekommer också då vi jobbar som ett team.

Din profil
Du har gymnasieutbildning och god datorvana, van att arbeta med datorer och appar. Dina kunskaper i svenska är goda i både tal och skrift och du behärskar även engelska. Vi önskar att du har arbetserfarenhet från liknande bransch där du arbetat med lager och logistik. Kunskap inom bygghandeln och byggmaterial är såklart mycket meriterande. Som person är du nyfiken, lyhörd, noggrann, kommunikativ och trivs att samarbeta med andra. Du har servicekänsla ut i fingerspetsarna och tar dig gladeligen an utmaningar. Krav för tjänsten är AM-/B-körkort, meriterande med truckkort.

Om tjänsten

Tjänsten är en tillsvidaretjänst på heltid, 38,25 h/ vecka.

Ansökan
Passar du in på ovanstående profil, tveka inte att ansöka redan idag. Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning, etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.

Har du frågor kring tjänsten? Hör av dig till Platschef Lars Lindberg, se kontaktuppgifter nedan.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Informatieanalist
description:
De digitale processen en informatievoorziening van HVC worden steeds complexer. Van afvalinzameling en transport tot urenverwerking, facturatie en rapportages: vrijwel iedere bedrijfsactiviteit is afhankelijk van betrouwbare data, goed ingerichte systemen en efficiënte digitale processen.

Binnen het domein Grondstoffen werken we continu aan het verbeteren en vernieuwen van deze processen. Daarbij ontstaan complexe vraagstukken waarbij bedrijfsprocessen, applicaties, data en verschillende stakeholders samenkomen. Denk aan systeemintegraties, procesverbeteringen of het koppelen van interne en externe databronnen.

We zoeken niet alleen iemand die informatiebehoeften analyseert, maar vooral iemand die richting geeft aan digitale oplossingen. Je brengt belangen samen, scheidt hoofd- van bijzaken en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar een heldere opdracht voor ontwikkelteams. Daardoor weten zij precies wat er moet worden gerealiseerd en waarom.

Je zorgt dat keuzes goed worden onderbouwd, draagvlak ontstaat en digitale verbeteringen succesvol worden gerealiseerd. Daarmee zorg je dat digitale veranderingen niet blijven hangen in ideeën, maar uitgroeien tot oplossingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt binnen de organisatie.

Ben jij een analytische verbinder die complexe vraagstukken terugbrengt tot duidelijke keuzes en realiseerbare digitale oplossingen?

Dit ga je doen

Je bent de inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor proceseigenaren en key-users binnen het domein Grondstoffen. Je onderzoekt gebruikersvragen, verbeterkansen en informatiebehoeften en achterhaalt de vraag achter de vraag. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de gewenste oplossing, maar ook naar de impact op processen, data, systemen en gebruikers.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en IT. Samen met gebruikers, ontwikkelaars, architecten, specialisten en leveranciers bepaal je de meest passende oplossingsrichting. Je maakt keuzes expliciet, legt kaders vast en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke requirements en concrete opdrachten voor het ontwikkelteam.

Als rechterhand van de Business Partner Digitalisering bewaak je de samenhang tussen processen, informatie, data en applicaties. Je beoordeelt oplossingsrichtingen op haalbaarheid, impact en beheerbaarheid en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het informatie- en applicatielandschap binnen het domein.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen, gebruikersvragen en informatiebehoeften;
  • vertalen van vraagstukken naar requirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria;
  • begeleiden van refinements en afstemmen van oplossingsrichtingen met stakeholders;
  • formuleren van duidelijke opdrachten en kaders voor ontwikkelteams;
  • beoordelen van de impact en haalbaarheid van veranderingen;
  • ondersteunen bij data-uitwisselingen, integraties, systeemwijzigingen en maatwerkoplossingen;
  • bewaken van de samenhang tussen processen, informatie en applicaties;
  • bijdragen aan een actuele informatie- en applicatiearchitectuur.

Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet alleen analyseert, maar ook richting geeft. Je brengt verschillende belangen samen, voorkomt en filtert ruis uit discussies door een heldere opdrachtomschrijving en zorgt dat complexe vraagstukken worden teruggebracht tot één duidelijke en uitvoerbare oplossing.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt terecht binnen de afdeling Digitalisering en richt je op het domein Grondstoffen. Hier ondersteunen en ontwikkelen we het digitale landschap achter het inzamelen, transporteren en registreren van afval- en grondstoffen. Van de afvalpas van inwoners tot de weegbruggen op verwerkingslocaties: jouw werk raakt direct aan de dagelijkse operatie van HVC.

Je werkt intensief samen met proceseigenaren, key-users, ontwikkelaars, architecten, leveranciers en de Business Partner Digitalisering. De lijnen zijn kort, de vraagstukken zijn uitdagend en je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en invloed uit te oefenen op digitale verbeteringen binnen HVC.

Onze collega Thomas, informatieanalist bij HVC:

"Van dashboard tot API en van idee tot implementatie: als informatieanalist verbind je mensen, processen en technologie tot één werkende oplossing."

title: Business Analyst
description:
Let's Write Africa's Story Together!

Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.

Job Description

The Business Analyst will support a broad portfolio of business, regulatory, operational and digital initiatives across Old Mutual International. A key focus of the role will be the analysis, design and enhancement of online tools and digital journeys, translating business, customer and regulatory needs into clear, practical requirements that support an effective user experience and business outcome.

Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams and subject matter experts, the Business Analyst will be responsible for gathering and documenting requirements, analysing processes and data flows, supporting solution design, and ensuring that technology solutions align with business objectives, operational requirements and regulatory obligations.

The role requires the ability to understand how information moves through systems, map requirements to data flows and downstream reporting needs, and assess the impact of change across processes, systems and customer journeys. While digital and online initiatives form an important part of the role, the Business Analyst will also contribute across a diverse range of business transformation, regulatory, operational improvement and product-related projects as required.

Key responsibilities will include amongst others the following:

Requirements Management

  • Plan and coordinate the identification and elicitation of requirements; conduct analysis of those requirements for completion and alignment.
  • Document and manage requirements throughout the life of the project; and coordinate the verification of the end deliverable.
  • Generally done at the project level.

Digital Solutions and User Experience

  • Support the design, enhancement and delivery of online tools, digital journeys and business solutions that meet customer, adviser and business needs.
  • Define and document business, functional, data and user requirements, ensuring solutions are intuitive, effective and aligned to business objectives.
  • Translate requirements into user stories, process flows, wireframe requirements, acceptance criteria and supporting documentation where appropriate.
  • Work collaboratively with business, technology, product and user experience stakeholders to support solution design and delivery.
  • Contribute to a broad range of business, operational, regulatory and digital initiatives across the organisation as priorities evolve.

Data Collection and Analysis

  • Make authoritative recommendations that have a significant impact on the business over the short and long term.
  • Recommendations could

be technical or professional in nature.

Database Specifications

  • Approve database specifications, ensuring all agreed standards and protocols are followed and data integrity is preserved.

Analysis of "As Is" and "To Be"

  • Document the most complex "as is" and "to be" processes and describe the changes required to migrate to the "to be" capability to record accurately the change required.

Business Requirements Identification

  • Elicit complex business requirements using a variety of methods, such as interviews, document analysis, workshops, and workflow analysis, to express the requirements in terms of target user roles and goals.

Feasibility Studies

  • Conduct feasibility studies from a technological and organizational perspective and document findings to complete cost-benefit analysis on implementing changes to business processes, products, or business unit structure.

Horizon Scanning

  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and contribute to the evaluation of their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.

Enterprise Business Analysis

  • Interpret the business need and identify solution recommendations to business problems at a business unit level. Lead the improvement efforts that are within span of control at this level.

Business Case

  • Develop straightforward business cases or lead feasibility and assessment work for proposed and current projects to support the development and continuous review of business cases.

Documentation and Backup

  • Create and maintain complex technical and/or user documentation to a high standard, and back up files to ensure instant recovery if problems occur.

Culture of Innovation

  • Drive a culture of innovation by creating multistakeholder solutions that boost creativity, innovation, and collaboration across business units,such as idea generation platforms, jam sessions, and hackathons.

Personal Capability Building

  • Act as subject matter expert in an area of technology, policy regulation, or operational management for the team.
  • Maintain external accreditations and in-depth understanding of current and emerging external regulation and industry best practices through continuing professional development, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.

These responsibilities offer an overview and a general outline of the role and are not exhaustive.

Qualifications and Experience required:

  • A relevant degree, advanced diploma or postgraduate qualification at NQF Level 7, preferably in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analysis or a related field.
  • Alternatively, a recognised Business Analysis qualification together with relevant practical experience.
  • Approximately ten years’ relevant experience in business analysis, systems analysis, technology delivery, digital enablement or a related environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in gathering, analysing, documenting and managing complex business and functional requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Experience developing user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, data flows and detailed requirements specifications.
  • Working knowledge of user experience and user interface principles, particularly in relation to online tools, digital journeys or customer-facing platforms.
  • A sound understanding of data flows, databases, data structures, system interfaces, data validation and data integrity.
  • Experience mapping business and system requirements to downstream data, operational and reporting processes.
  • Experience working with business and technology stakeholders to support solution design, testing, implementation and post-implementation validation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex processes and translate them into clear, practical requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Financial services, wealth management or investment industry experience would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of offshore investment products, cross-jurisdictional processes or regulatory reporting requirements would be a distinct advantage.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methods, requirements management tools and process-modelling techniques would be beneficial.

Skills

Adaptive Thinking, Analytics Software, Business Case Development, Business Intelligence (BI) Analysis, Business Requirements Analysis, Business Requirements Elicitation, Computer Literacy, Current State Assessment, Database Reporting, Data Compilation, Data Controls, Gap Analysis, Readiness Assessments, Requirements Development, User Requirements Documentation

Competencies

Action Oriented

Business Insight

Cultivates Innovation

Customer Focus

Decision Quality

Manages Complexity

Nimble Learning

Optimizes Work Processes

Education

NQF Level 7 - Degree, Advance Diploma or Postgraduate Certificate or equivalent

09 September 2026 , 23:59

description:
